class UnitReviewCheckSource:
    """ReviewerSourcePort backed by original UnitRecords and same-authority blobs."""

    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, records: AuthorizedAcpTurnReader,
                 blobs, *, bindings: UnitReviewBindingResolver,
                 reviewer_authority: UnitReviewerAuthority | None = None):
        if (getattr(method_control, 'factory', None) is not factory
                or getattr(blobs, 'authority_id', None) != getattr(factory, 'authority_id', None)):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        if records is None or bindings is None:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE')
        self.factory, self.methods, self.records, self.blobs = factory, method_control, records, blobs
        self.bindings, self.authority = bindings, reviewer_authority

    @staticmethod
    def _binding(value, plan):
        if (type(value) is not UnitReviewBinding
                or type(value.plan_digest) is not Digest
                or type(value.request_version) is not int or value.request_version < 0
                or type(value.request_fence) is not int or value.request_fence < 1
                or type(value.unit_ref) is not dict
                or set(value.unit_ref) != {'environmentNamespace', 'unitId', 'ownerProviderRef', 'sourceRevision'}
                or type(value.delivery_refs) is not tuple
                or not value.delivery_refs
                or any(type(ref) is not ArtifactRevisionRef for ref in value.delivery_refs)
                or len(set(value.delivery_refs)) != len(value.delivery_refs)
                or type(value.response_schema_ref) is not ResourceRef
                or type(value.response_document_type) is not str or not value.response_document_type
                or type(value.response_schema) is not bytes or not value.response_schema
                or len(value.response_schema) > 262144
                or type(value.response_schema_digest) is not Digest
                or value.response_schema_digest.algorithm != 'sha256'
                or hashlib.sha256(value.response_schema).hexdigest() != value.response_schema_digest.hex
                or value.response_schema_ref.sha256 != value.response_schema_digest.hex
                or type(value.required_check_keys) is not tuple
                or not value.required_check_keys
                or len(set(value.required_check_keys)) != len(value.required_check_keys)
                or set(value.required_check_keys) != set(plan.check_keys)
                or not isinstance(value.reviewer_identity_constraints, Mapping)
                or not value.reviewer_identity_constraints):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_BINDING_INVALID')
        try:
            if len(canonical_bytes(dict(value.reviewer_identity_constraints))) > 65536:
                raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_BINDING_INVALID')
        except (TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_BINDING_INVALID') from exc
        return value

    @staticmethod
    def _text(receipt):
        summary = receipt.get('summary')
        if (not isinstance(summary, dict) or type(summary.get('text')) is not str
                or not summary['text'] or summary.get('modelQualityVerified') is not False):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        return summary['text']

    def _standard(self, snapshot, plan, supplied):
        standards = [item for item in snapshot.program.standard_definitions
            if item.standard_id == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id
            and item.resource_ref.sha256 == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex]
        if len(standards) != 1 or (supplied is not None and supplied != standards[0]):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
        return standards[0]

    def _schema_value(self, snapshot, binding, text):
        if len(text.encode('utf-8')) > 262144:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_BOUND_EXCEEDED')
        resources = [item for item in snapshot.resources
            if item.resource_id == binding.response_schema_ref.resource_id
            and item.digest == binding.response_schema_ref.sha256]
        documents = [item for item in snapshot.program.document_definitions
            if item.document_type == binding.response_document_type
            and item.schema_resource == binding.response_schema_ref]
        if (len(resources) != 1 or len(documents) != 1
                or binding.response_schema_ref.kind != 'document_schema'
                or documents[0].validation_target != 'method_content'):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE')
        resource = resources[0]
        stored = resource.blob_ref
        try:
            snapshot_store = getattr(self.methods, 'snapshots', None)
            if snapshot_store is None or getattr(snapshot_store, 'library', None) is not self.factory.library:
                raise ValueError('same original snapshot store required')
            actual_schema = snapshot_store.read_blob(stored)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE') from exc
        if (actual_schema != binding.response_schema
                or hashlib.sha256(actual_schema).hexdigest() != binding.response_schema_digest.hex
                or resource.byte_length != len(actual_schema)
                or resource.media_type != stored.media_type):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_SCHEMA_MISMATCH')
        try:
            def no_duplicates(pairs):
                result = {}
                for key, value in pairs:
                    if key in result:
                        raise ValueError('duplicate json key')
                    result[key] = value
                return result
            value = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=no_duplicates,
                               parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('invalid constant')))
        except (ValueError, TypeError, RecursionError) as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID') from exc
        from .method_content import validate_document_content
        validation = validate_document_content(snapshot, binding.response_document_type, {'value': value})
        if not validation.ok:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID')
        return value

    def _capture(self, context, plan, request, standard, snapshot, raw_ref):
        if type(raw_ref) is not BlobRef:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        binding = self._binding(
            self.bindings.resolve_unit_review(context, plan, request, standard=standard), plan)
        if (binding.plan_digest != plan.plan_digest
                or binding.request_version != request.version
                or binding.request_fence != request.fence):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_REQUEST_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        if self.authority is None:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        captured = capture_execution_observation(
            self.records, self.blobs, authority_id=self.factory.authority_id,
            unit_ref=binding.unit_ref, operation_ref=binding.operation_ref,
            expected_prompt_digest=binding.expected_prompt_digest,
            query_invocation=binding.query_invocation)
        if captured.state != 'completed' or captured.expected_prompt_digest != binding.expected_prompt_digest:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_NOT_COMPLETED')
        raw = self.blobs.read_verified(captured.blob_ref)
        try:
            receipt = decode_json(raw)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RECEIPT_INVALID') from exc
        if canonical_bytes(receipt) != raw or type(receipt) is not dict:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RECEIPT_INVALID')
        text = self._text(receipt)
        # The exact delivery/schema/check selection must be part of the frozen
        # prompt whose digest the trusted resolver supplies. The captured
        # UnitRecords inputDigest is that prompt digest. The command's raw
        # response bytes must also be the exact completed Unit response text.
        try:
            submitted = self.blobs.read_verified(raw_ref)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID') from exc
        if submitted != text.encode('utf-8'):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_MISMATCH')
        response_value = self._schema_value(snapshot, binding, text)
        try:
            answers = self.bindings.decode_response(binding, response_value, plan=plan, standard=standard)
        except ApplicationError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID') from exc
        if (type(answers) is not tuple or len(answers) != len(plan.check_keys)
                or any(type(answer) is not CriterionAnswer for answer in answers)
                or len({answer.check_key for answer in answers}) != len(answers)
                or {answer.check_key for answer in answers} != set(plan.check_keys)):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE')
        review_observations(plan, standard, answers)
        return binding, captured, answers

    def verify_response(self, context, plan, request, raw_response_ref, *, standard):
        with self.methods.guard_method(context, plan.requirement.method_ref) as snapshot:
            standard = self._standard(snapshot, plan, standard)
            binding, captured, answers = self._capture(
                context, plan, request, standard, snapshot, raw_response_ref)
            observations = review_observations(plan, standard, answers)
            obs_digest = observations_digest(observations)
            try:
                guard = self.authority.guard_unit_reviewer(
                    context, plan, request, binding, raw_response_ref, obs_digest)
                with guard as evidence:
                    self._validate_evidence(context, plan, request, raw_response_ref, obs_digest, evidence)
                    return VerifiedReviewResponse(evidence, answers)
            except ApplicationError:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_TRUST_UNAVAILABLE') from exc

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_evidence(context, plan, request, raw_ref, obs_digest, evidence):
        if (type(evidence) is not VerifiedReviewerEvidence or evidence.scope != context.scope
                or evidence.request_digest != plan.request_digest
                or evidence.raw_response_digest != raw_ref.digest
                or evidence.observations_digest != obs_digest
                or not set(plan.reviewer_requirements).issubset(evidence.roles)):
            raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')

    @contextmanager
    def guard_trust(self, context, records):
        if self.authority is None:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        if type(records) is not tuple:
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT')
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            current = []
            for record in records:
                plan = record.plan
                snapshot = stack.enter_context(self.methods.guard_method(context, plan.requirement.method_ref))
                standards = [s for s in snapshot.program.standard_definitions
                        if s.standard_id == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id
                        and s.resource_ref.sha256 == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex]
                if len(standards) != 1:
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
                standard = standards[0]
                request = self._request_for_record(context, record)
                binding, captured, answers = self._capture(
                    context, plan, request, standard, snapshot, record.raw_response_ref)
                observations = review_observations(plan, standard, answers)
                if observations != record.observations:
                    raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_CHANGED')
                guard = self.authority.guard_unit_reviewer(
                    context, plan, request, binding, record.raw_response_ref,
                    observations_digest(observations), expected=record.reviewer_evidence)
                evidence = stack.enter_context(guard)
                self._validate_evidence(context, plan, request, record.raw_response_ref,
                                        observations_digest(observations), evidence)
                if evidence != record.reviewer_evidence:
                    raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
                current.append(CurrentReviewTrust(record.ref, evidence.verifier_id, evidence.trust_version))
            yield tuple(current)

    def _request_for_record(self, context, record):
        resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_record_request', None)
        if not callable(resolver):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_REQUEST_RESOLVER_UNAVAILABLE')
        request = resolver(context, record.plan, record)
        if (request is None or request.scope != context.scope
                or request.review_id != record.plan.review_id
                or type(request.version) is not int
                or request.version < 0 or type(request.fence) is not int or request.fence < 1):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_REQUEST_CHANGED')
        return request

This pure conversion does not authenticate a Unit, validate live source trust,
resolve evidence bytes, choose reviewer roles or turn an answer into a Grant.
The caller holds the original method/source guards and records through admission.
"""
import json
from ...application.contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ...application.contracts.reviewer_admission import CriterionAnswer
from ...application.usecases.reviews.admission import review_observations
from ...domain.common.mechanisms.codec import require_object, decode_digest
from ...domain.common.outcomes.diagnostics import ReferenceError
from ...domain.common.models.values import validate_text
from ...domain.artifacts.ref_codec import decode_artifact_ref
from ...domain.reviews.target_codec import decode_target
from ...domain.reviews.models import CheckKey, ReviewPlan

MAX_UNIT_REVIEW_BYTES = 262144


def _pairs(items):
    value = {}
    for key, item in items:
        if key in value:
            raise ValueError('duplicate JSON property')
        value[key] = item
    return value


def decode_unit_review_result(plan, standard, raw_text, *, snapshot, document_type):
    """Decode the method-selected version-1 answer document for an exact plan.

    `document_type` and `snapshot` come from trusted composition/current method
    binding, never from an untrusted response selecting its own schema. No method
    name, phase, criterion, disposition policy or author!=reviewer rule is fixed.
    Every original key is required; answer order is canonicalized to plan order.
    """
    if type(plan) is not ReviewPlan or type(snapshot) is not MethodSnapshot:
        raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_BINDING_INVALID')
    pinned = plan.requirement.method_ref
    actual = snapshot.ref
    if (actual.method_id, actual.release_version, actual.schema_version, actual.snapshot_digest) != (
            pinned.method_id, pinned.release_version, pinned.schema_version, pinned.snapshot_digest.hex):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    standards = [s for s in snapshot.program.standard_definitions
                 if s.standard_id == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id
                 and s.resource_ref.sha256 == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex]
    if len(standards) != 1 or standard != standards[0]:
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    try:
        if type(raw_text) is not str or not raw_text or len(raw_text.encode('utf-8')) > MAX_UNIT_REVIEW_BYTES:
            raise ValueError('invalid response text bound')
        value = json.loads(raw_text, object_pairs_hook=_pairs,
            parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('nonfinite JSON constant')))
        require_object(value, {'schema_version','document_type','plan_digest','answers'}, 'INVALID_SCHEMA')
        if (type(value['schema_version']) is not int or value['schema_version'] != 1
                or type(document_type) is not str or not document_type
                or value['document_type'] != document_type):
            raise ValueError('selected response document differs')
        validation = validate_document_content(snapshot, document_type, {'value':value})
        if not validation.ok:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID')
        if decode_digest(value['plan_digest']) != plan.plan_digest:
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
        rows = value['answers']
        if type(rows) is not list or len(rows) != len(plan.check_keys):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE')
        decoded = {}
        for row in rows:
            require_object(row, {'check_key','status','evidence_refs','rationale'}, 'INVALID_SCHEMA')
            key = row['check_key']
            require_object(key, {'target','criterion_id','claim_id'}, 'INVALID_SCHEMA')
            key = CheckKey(decode_target(key['target']), key['criterion_id'], key['claim_id'])
            if key in decoded or key not in plan.check_keys:
                raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE')
            if row['status'] not in ('satisfied','violated','insufficient','unknown') or type(row['status']) is not str:
                raise ValueError('invalid semantic answer status')
            validate_text(row['rationale'])
            if type(row['evidence_refs']) is not list:
                raise ValueError('evidence refs must be an array')
            evidence = tuple(decode_artifact_ref(ref) for ref in row['evidence_refs'])
            if (len(set(evidence)) != len(evidence) or any((ref.realm_id, ref.project_id) != (
                    plan.scope.realm_id, plan.scope.project_id) for ref in evidence)):
                raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
            decoded[key] = CriterionAnswer(key, row['status'], evidence, row['rationale'])
        if set(decoded) != set(plan.check_keys):
            raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE')
        answers = tuple(decoded[key] for key in plan.check_keys)
        review_observations(plan, standard, answers)
        return answers
    except ApplicationError:
        raise
    except (ReferenceError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, UnicodeError, RecursionError, AttributeError) as exc:
        raise ApplicationError('UNIT_REVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID') from exc

from contextlib import ExitStack
from dataclasses import asdict
from uuid import uuid4
from ordessa_infrastructure.encoding import canonical_bytes
from ...contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ..approvals.service import ApprovalUseCases
from .acceptance_closure import resolve_submission_acceptance

from ....domain.approvals.ref_codec import decode_approval_ref
from ....domain.artifacts.ref_codec import decode_artifact_ref

def resolve_acceptance_intent(uow, intent, submission_ref):
    """Whole current original closure; no client requirement/target filtering."""
    if type(intent) is not AuthorizationIntent or intent.scope != uow.scope:
        raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
    closure=resolve_submission_acceptance(uow,submission_ref)
    if (intent.method_ref!=closure.package.payload.method_ref
            or set(intent.targets)!=set(closure.submission.output_refs)
            or len(intent.targets)!=len(closure.submission.output_refs)
            or any(r.purpose!='acceptance' for r in intent.required_review_requirements)
            or sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(r)) for r in intent.required_review_requirements)
                !=sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(r)) for r in closure.requirements)):
        raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    return closure


class AcceptanceUseCases(ApprovalUseCases):
    def __init__(self,factory,access,admission=None,review_admission=None,*,acceptance_admission=None,submission_source=None):
        super().__init__(factory,access,admission,review_admission)
        if acceptance_admission is not None and getattr(acceptance_admission,'factory',None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.acceptance_admission=acceptance_admission
        self.submission_source=submission_source

    def adopt(self,parameters,context,*,read_set=None):
        op='engineering.acceptance.adopt'
        value,reads,digest=self._input(op,parameters,context,read_set)
        try:
            approval=decode_approval_ref(value['approval_ref'])
            subject=decode_subject_ref(value['submission_ref'])
            if type(subject) is not SubmissionRef:
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN')
            targets=[]
            for row in value['targets']:
                require_object(row,{'target_ref','expected'},'INVALID_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET')
                head=row['expected']
                require_object(head,{'artifact_id','version','head_ref'},'INVALID_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET')
                targets.append(AcceptanceTarget(decode_artifact_ref(row['target_ref']),
                    HeadExpectation(head['artifact_id'],head['version'],
                        None if head['head_ref'] is None else decode_artifact_ref(head['head_ref']))))
        except (ReferenceError,TypeError,ValueError,KeyError):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from None
        replay=self._replay(op,context,digest)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay  # Historical receipt read, never re-debit/re-apply.
        if self.acceptance_admission is None:
            raise ApplicationError('ACCEPTANCE_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE')
        if self.submission_source is None:
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            grant=uow.authorization.get_grant(approval)
            control=uow.authorization.get_control(approval)
            intent=grant.intent
            if type(intent) is not AuthorizationIntent:
                raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
            closure=resolve_acceptance_intent(uow,intent,subject)
            try:
                plan=AcceptancePlan(context.scope,subject,intent.acceptance_use,tuple(targets))
            except ReferenceError as exc:
                raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from exc
        if control['state']!='granted' or control['version']!=value['expected_control_version']:
            raise ApplicationError('APPROVAL_CONTROL_CHANGED')
        if {t.target_ref for t in plan.targets}!=set(intent.targets):
            raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        with ExitStack() as guards:
            guards.enter_context(self.acceptance_admission.guard_intent(context,intent))
            guards.enter_context(self._admission().guard_intent(context,intent))
            guards.enter_context(self._admission().guard_evidence(context,intent,grant.evidence))
            decisions=guards.enter_context(self._gates(context,intent))
            guards.enter_context(self.submission_source.guard_submission(context,closure.submission,closure.package))
            def mutate(uow):
                if uow.authorization.get_grant(approval)!=grant or uow.authorization.get_control(approval)!=control:
                    raise ApplicationError('APPROVAL_CONTROL_CHANGED')
                current=resolve_acceptance_intent(uow,intent,subject)
                if current!=closure:
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_BINDING_CHANGED')
                self._resolve(uow,intent)  # Exact original notice/summary/target binding.
                self._check_gates(uow,decisions)
                from ..support.clock import utc_now
                now = utc_now()
                action_id=str(uuid4())
                # All target version/head/graph checks precede every head effect.
                uow.engineering.apply_acceptance_plan(plan)
                uow.authorization.consume_action(approval,action='accept_artifact',
                    action_instance_id=action_id,target_digest=plan.digest,now=now)
                review_refs=tuple(sorted({r for d in decisions for r in d.used_review_refs},
                    key=lambda r:canonical_bytes(asdict(r))))
                receipt=AcceptanceReceipt(context.scope,str(uuid4()),action_id,approval,intent.digest,
                    plan,review_refs,control['version'],now)
                ref=uow.acceptance.create(receipt)
                return {'acceptance_receipt_ref':asdict(ref),'submission_ref':asdict(subject),
                    'acceptance_use':intent.acceptance_use,'accepted':True,
                    'target_refs':[asdict(t.target_ref) for t in plan.targets]}
            return self._run(op,context,reads,digest,mutate)

"""Exact package/submission closure for formal result acceptance.

This module resolves persisted facts through the caller's original UoW. It does
not issue authority or decide a review verdict.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from ordessa_infrastructure.encoding import canonical_bytes

from ...contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ...contracts.snapshots import EngineeringTargetBindings
from ..proposal_closure import resolve_record
from ....domain.approvals.implementation import ImplementationAuthorizationIntent
from ....domain.changes.submission import Submission
from ....domain.changes.submission_binding import validate_submission_graph
from ....domain.common.outcomes.diagnostics import ReferenceError
from ....domain.packages.models import ImplementationPackage
from ....domain.reviews.refs import SubmissionRef
from ....domain.reviews.requirements import expand_submission_requirement
from ....domain.artifacts.refs import ArtifactRevisionRef


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubmissionAcceptanceClosure:
    submission: Submission
    package: ImplementationPackage
    requirements: tuple
    artifact_revisions: tuple
    proposals: tuple
    templates: tuple


def resolve_submission_acceptance(uow, submission_ref):
    """Resolve the full exact acceptance subject set on one active UoW.

    The package reference comes only from the immutable Submission. Proposal,
    grant, template and revision identities are re-read from their original
    owners; no client-selected requirement list or latest-record lookup is used.
    """
    if type(submission_ref) is not SubmissionRef or submission_ref.project_id != uow.scope.project_id or submission_ref.realm_id != uow.scope.realm_id:
        raise ApplicationError('SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    submission = uow.submissions.resolve(submission_ref)
    package = uow.implementation.resolve_package(submission.package_ref)
    payload = package.payload
    if (submission.scope != uow.scope or package.scope != uow.scope
            or submission.package_ref != package.ref
            or submission.authorization_refs != payload.authorization_refs
            or submission.change_set != payload.change_set):
        raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_PACKAGE_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    grant = uow.authorization.get_grant(payload.authorization_refs[0])
    if type(grant.intent) is not ImplementationAuthorizationIntent:
        raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
    intent, spec = grant.intent, grant.intent.implementation_spec
    if (payload.authorization_refs != (grant.ref,) or payload.change_set != intent.change_set
            or set(payload.design_targets) != set(intent.targets)
            or payload.method_ref != intent.method_ref
            or payload.baseline_snapshots != spec.expected_baselines
            or payload.implementation_intent_id != spec.implementation_intent_id
            or payload.derivation.intent_digest != intent.digest
            or payload.acceptance_requirements != spec.acceptance_requirement_refs
            or not set(payload.allowed_actions) <= set(intent.actions)
            or set(payload.required_review_refs) != set(intent.supporting_review_refs)
            or payload.execution_profile_ref not in spec.scope.environment_refs):
        raise ApplicationError('PACKAGE_GRANT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    scopes = dict(intent.scope_by_action)
    for row in payload.resolved_file_manifest:
        path, destination = ((row.rename_from, row.path) if row.operation == 'rename' else (row.path, None))
        if ('generate_package' not in scopes
                or not scopes['generate_package'].allows_path(row.repository_id, path, row.operation,
                    destination=destination)
                or 'edit_repository' in payload.allowed_actions and
                   ('edit_repository' not in scopes or not scopes['edit_repository'].allows_path(
                       row.repository_id, path, row.operation, destination=destination))):
            raise ApplicationError('PACKAGE_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    # Historical dispatch/source binding is immutable evidence. It must still
    # resolve exactly, while current grant control is intentionally not used to
    # decide whether already captured output facts exist.
    from ...orchestration.steps.implementation_dispatch import resolve_dispatch_submission_binding
    resolve_dispatch_submission_binding(uow, submission)
    proposals_by_ref = {}
    proposal_templates = {}
    budget = uow.proposals.validated_budget()
    for proposal_ref in payload.change_set.proposal_refs:
        proposal = uow.proposals.get_proposal(proposal_ref, budget=budget)
        if proposal.implementation_intent != spec:
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_PACKAGE_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        # This validates the current Proposal and the complete frozen template
        # set against its exact revisions, while ordinary deferred templates
        # remain deliberately unexpanded here.
        resolve_record(proposal, uow.proposals, budget)
        roots = tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in proposal.mutations)
        roots += tuple(m.base_ref for m in proposal.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)
        roots += tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for c in proposal.claim_refs)
        graph = uow.proposals.resolve_revision_graph(roots, budget)
        proposals_by_ref[proposal_ref] = (proposal, graph)
        proposal_templates[proposal_ref] = tuple(t for t in proposal.review_requirement_templates if t.deferred)
    if set(proposals_by_ref) != set(payload.change_set.proposal_refs):
        raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_PACKAGE_BINDING_MISMATCH')

    expected_refs = tuple(spec.acceptance_requirement_refs)
    actual_refs = tuple(t.ref for rows in proposal_templates.values() for t in rows)
    package_refs = tuple(payload.acceptance_requirements)
    if (len(actual_refs) != len(set(actual_refs)) or set(actual_refs) != set(expected_refs)
            or set(package_refs) != set(expected_refs) or len(package_refs) != len(expected_refs)):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    coverage = {c.proposal_ref: c for c in payload.proposal_coverage}
    if set(coverage) != set(proposal_templates):
        raise ApplicationError('PACKAGE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE')
    for proposal_ref, templates in proposal_templates.items():
        refs = tuple(t.ref for t in templates)
        if (set(coverage[proposal_ref].acceptance_requirements) != set(refs)
                or len(coverage[proposal_ref].acceptance_requirements) != len(refs)):
            raise ApplicationError('PACKAGE_COVERAGE_MISMATCH')

    baselines = tuple(uow.implementation.resolve_repository_baseline(r) for r in submission.baseline_snapshots)
    resulting = tuple(uow.implementation.resolve_repository_baseline(r) for r in submission.resulting_snapshots)
    validate_submission_graph(submission, package, grant, baselines, resulting)
    output_refs = tuple(submission.output_refs)
    if not output_refs or any(type(ref) is not ArtifactRevisionRef for ref in output_refs):
        raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_OUTPUT_UNSUPPORTED')
    revisions_by_ref = {}
    for ref in output_refs:
        revisions_by_ref[ref] = uow.engineering.resolve_revision(ref)
    requirements, templates = [], []
    for proposal_ref in payload.change_set.proposal_refs:
        for template in proposal_templates[proposal_ref]:
            if template.purpose != 'acceptance':
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REVIEW_PURPOSE_UNAVAILABLE')
            templates.append(template)
            try:
                requirements.append(expand_submission_requirement(template, submission_ref,
                    spec.implementation_intent_id, output_refs, revisions_by_ref))
            except ReferenceError as exc:
                raise ApplicationError(exc.code) from exc
    if not requirements or len({r.requirement_id for r in requirements}) != len(requirements):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    return SubmissionAcceptanceClosure(submission, package, tuple(requirements),
        tuple(revisions_by_ref[ref] for ref in output_refs),
        tuple(proposals_by_ref[r][0] for r in payload.change_set.proposal_refs), tuple(templates))


def _canonical_set(records):
    return sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(value)) for value in records)


class SubmissionAcceptanceIntentAdmission:
    """Current method and business-owner guard for an exact acceptance intent."""
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, bindings):
        if getattr(method_control, 'factory', None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory, self.methods, self.bindings = factory, method_control, bindings
        from ...orchestration.method_bridge import MethodBridge
        self.bridge = MethodBridge()

    @contextmanager
    def guard_intent(self, context, intent):
        from ....domain.approvals.consent import AuthorizationIntent
        if (type(intent) is not AuthorizationIntent or intent.scope != context.scope
                or intent.actions != ('accept_artifact',)):
            raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
        selector = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_acceptance_submission', None)
        phase_resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_submission_bindings', None)
        if not callable(selector) or not callable(phase_resolver):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_TARGET_BINDINGS_UNAVAILABLE')
        submission_ref = selector(context, intent)
        if (type(submission_ref) is not SubmissionRef
                or (submission_ref.realm_id, submission_ref.project_id) !=
                   (context.scope.realm_id, context.scope.project_id)):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context, intent.method_ref) as snapshot:
            phases = phase_resolver(context, intent.method_ref, submission_ref)
            if (type(phases) is not tuple or not phases or len(phases) > 4096
                    or any(type(binding) is not EngineeringTargetBindings
                           or binding.scope != context.scope
                           or binding.review_purpose != 'acceptance' for binding in phases)
                    or len({binding.phase_key for binding in phases}) != len(phases)):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            for binding in phases:
                self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, binding)
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope, 'read') as uow:
                closure = resolve_submission_acceptance(uow, submission_ref)
            payload = closure.package.payload
            if payload.method_ref != intent.method_ref:
                raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            self.bridge.submission_review_requirements(snapshot, phases,
                requirements=closure.requirements, revisions=closure.artifact_revisions)
            output_refs = {record.ref for record in closure.artifact_revisions}
            if (set(intent.targets) != output_refs
                    or len(intent.targets) != len(output_refs)
                    or not intent.required_review_requirements
                    or any(requirement.purpose != 'acceptance'
                           or requirement.method_ref != intent.method_ref
                           or requirement.scope != context.scope
                           or any(type(target.ref) is not ArtifactRevisionRef
                                  for target in requirement.expected_targets.targets)
                           for requirement in intent.required_review_requirements)
                    or {target.ref for requirement in intent.required_review_requirements
                        for target in requirement.expected_targets.targets} != output_refs
                    or _canonical_set(intent.required_review_requirements) !=
                       _canonical_set(closure.requirements)):
                raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            yield closure

from dataclasses import asdict
from contextlib import contextmanager

from ordessa_infrastructure.encoding import canonical_bytes
from ordessa_engineering.application.contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ordessa_engineering.domain.approvals.consent import ChangeAuthorizationIntent

class ChangeIntentAdmission:
    """Complete Change intent closure over original method and Proposal owners.

    Bindings are injected by trusted composition; no phase list is inferred from
    the caller's requirements. The method guard remains entered through the
    consuming original UoW COMMIT, including its BEGIN-time control fences.
    """
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, bindings):
        from ...orchestration.method_bridge import MethodBridge
        if getattr(method_control, 'factory', None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory, self.methods, self.bindings = factory, method_control, bindings
        self.bridge = MethodBridge()

    @contextmanager
    def guard_intent(self, context, intent):
        if type(intent) is not ChangeAuthorizationIntent:
            raise ApplicationError('INTENT_OWNER_UNAVAILABLE')
        if intent.scope != context.scope:
            raise ApplicationError('SCOPE_MISMATCH')
        resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_intent_bindings', None)
        if not callable(resolver):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_TARGET_BINDINGS_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context, intent.method_ref) as snapshot:
            complete = []
            # No resolver callback runs inside the read transaction: it may
            # itself need original business reads on the same library.
            bindings_by_proposal = tuple((ref, resolver(context, intent.method_ref, ref))
                                         for ref in intent.change_set.proposal_refs)
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope, 'read') as uow:
                resolve_change_intent(uow, intent)
                budget = uow.proposals.validated_budget()
                for ref, phases in bindings_by_proposal:
                    if (type(phases) is not tuple or not phases
                            or any(type(b) is not EngineeringTargetBindings for b in phases)
                            or len({b.phase_key for b in phases}) != len(phases)):
                        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                    for phase in phases:
                        self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, phase)
                    proposal = uow.proposals.get_proposal(ref, budget=budget)
                    frozen = resolve_record(proposal, uow.proposals, budget)
                    roots = tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in proposal.mutations)
                    roots += tuple(m.base_ref for m in proposal.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)
                    roots += tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for c in proposal.claim_refs)
                    revisions = uow.proposals.resolve_revision_graph(roots, budget)
                    owners = tuple(uow.engineering.get_artifact(m.artifact_id) for m in proposal.mutations)
                    # Bridge uses the original proposal validator, which must
                    # read create as the original create request, not adoption.
                    from dataclasses import replace
                    owners = tuple(replace(o, head_revision_id=None) for o in owners)
                    if any(b.scope != context.scope for b in phases):
                        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                    expected = self.bridge.proposal_review_requirements(snapshot, phases,
                        proposal=proposal, artifacts=owners, revisions=revisions)
                    if _canonical_requirements(expected) != _canonical_requirements(frozen):
                        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
                    complete.extend(expected)
                if _canonical_requirements(complete) != _canonical_requirements(intent.required_review_requirements):
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
            yield


def _canonical_requirements(requirements):
    return sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(r)) for r in requirements)


def resolve_change_intent(uow, intent):
    """Resolve the actual full Proposal contract, never a client's subset."""
    if type(intent) is not ChangeAuthorizationIntent:
        raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
    # This also requires explicit schema9 rather than silently storing a new
    # action branch in an old schema8 library.
    uow.authorization.require_apply_schema()
    budget = uow.proposals.validated_budget()
    proposals = tuple(uow.proposals.get_proposal(ref, budget=budget) for ref in intent.change_set.proposal_refs)
    controls = tuple(uow.proposals.get_control(p.ref, budget=budget) for p in proposals)
    if ChangeSet(tuple(p.ref for p in proposals)) != intent.change_set or any(p.method_ref != intent.method_ref for p in proposals):
        raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    requirements = tuple(r for p in proposals for r in resolve_record(p, uow.proposals, budget))
    # Canonical full content compares identifiers, targets, criteria, roles and
    # check keys together. Equal IDs with substituted contents do not bind.
    if sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(r)) for r in requirements) != sorted(
            canonical_bytes(asdict(r)) for r in intent.required_review_requirements):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    targets = tuple(m.proposed_ref for p in proposals for m in p.mutations)
    if set(targets) != set(intent.targets) or len(targets) != len(intent.targets):
        raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    roots = targets + tuple(m.base_ref for p in proposals for m in p.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)
    roots += tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for p in proposals for c in p.claim_refs)
    revisions = uow.proposals.resolve_revision_graph(roots, budget)
    ids = sorted({m.artifact_id for p in proposals for m in p.mutations})
    owners = tuple(uow.engineering.get_artifact(identifier) for identifier in ids)
    try:
        return plan_change_application(proposals, controls, owners, revisions, intent.expected_heads)
    except ReferenceError as refusal:
        raise ApplicationError(refusal.code) from refusal


class ChangeApplyUseCases(ApprovalUseCases):
    def apply(self, parameters, context, *, read_set=None):
        op = 'engineering.changes.apply'
        value, reads, digest = self._input(op, parameters, context, read_set)
        try:
            ref = decode_approval_ref(value['approval_ref'])
        except (ReferenceError, TypeError, ValueError):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from None
        replay = self._replay(op, context, digest)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope, 'read') as uow:
            grant = uow.authorization.get_grant(ref)
            control = uow.authorization.get_control(ref)
        intent = grant.intent
        if type(intent) is not ChangeAuthorizationIntent:
            raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
        if control['state'] != 'granted':
            raise ApplicationError('AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED')
        def mutate(uow):
            if uow.authorization.get_grant(ref) != grant or uow.authorization.get_control(ref) != control:
                raise ApplicationError('AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED')
            plan = self._resolve(uow, intent)
            self._check_gates(uow, decisions)
            action_id = str(uuid4())  # Original application generates the identity.
            uow.authorization.consume_action(ref, action='apply_change', action_instance_id=action_id,
                target_digest=intent.change_set.digest, now=context.received_at)
            uow.engineering.apply_head_plan(plan)
            receipt = ChangeApplicationReceipt(context.scope, str(uuid4()), action_id, ref, intent.digest,
                intent.change_set, plan.mutations,
                tuple(sorted({r for d in decisions for r in d.used_review_refs}, key=lambda r: canonical_bytes(asdict(r)))),
                control['version'], context.received_at)
            uow.authorization.put_apply(receipt)
            return {'state': 'APPLIED', 'apply_receipt': asdict(receipt),
                    'target_baseline_refs': [asdict(m.proposed_ref) for m in plan.mutations]}
        with self._admission().guard_intent(context, intent), self._gates(context, intent) as decisions:
            return self._run(op, context, reads, digest, mutate)

"""Capture one authorized original UnitRecords ACP observation into Engineering's BlobStore."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from ordessa_infrastructure.encoding.canonical_json import canonical_bytes, LIBRARY_JSON_PROFILE

from ....application.contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ....application.contracts.execution_observations import ExecutionObservationRef
from ....domain.common.models.values import Digest
from ....domain.common.models.refs import BlobRef


_STATES = {'reserved', 'possibly-written', 'completed', 'failed', 'unknown'}


def _plain_view(value, depth=0):
    # Public Execution records are recursively sealed mapping/tuple views.
    # Preserve every JSON field while making those views encodable by the
    # original neutral canonical encoder; this performs no semantic projection.
    if depth > 32:
        raise ValueError('execution observation depth bound exceeded')
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {key: _plain_view(item, depth+1) for key,item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list,tuple)):
        return [_plain_view(item, depth+1) for item in value]
    return value


def capture_execution_observation(records, blobs, *, authority_id, unit_ref, operation_ref,
                                  expected_prompt_digest, query_invocation):
    """Authorized cold-read and byte capture only; does not create a Submission or Grant."""
    if (not isinstance(unit_ref, Mapping)
            or set(unit_ref) != {'environmentNamespace','unitId','ownerProviderRef','sourceRevision'}
            or type(operation_ref) is not str or not 0 < len(operation_ref) <= 256
            or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in operation_ref)):
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_IDENTITY_REQUIRED')
    if type(expected_prompt_digest) is not str or not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', expected_prompt_digest):
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_PROMPT_DIGEST_REQUIRED')
    if query_invocation is None:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_QUERY_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED')
    if type(authority_id) is not str or not authority_id or getattr(blobs, 'authority_id', None) != authority_id:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_BLOB_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')

    query_digest = records.acp_turn_query_digest(unit_ref, operation_ref, expected_prompt_digest)
    facts = getattr(query_invocation, 'facts', None)
    if not isinstance(facts, Mapping) or facts.get('inputDigest') != query_digest:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_QUERY_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    try:
        receipt = records.query_acp_turn(
            unit_ref, operation_ref, query_invocation, input_digest=query_digest,
            expected_prompt_input_digest=expected_prompt_digest)
    except Exception as exc:
        # Preserve the records authority's refusal; never turn it into an unauthorised read.
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_QUERY_REFUSED') from exc

    if not isinstance(receipt, Mapping):
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_RECEIPT_INVALID')
    state = receipt.get('state')
    revision = receipt.get('revision')
    if (receipt.get('contractVersion') != 'unit-acp-turn/1'
            or receipt.get('unitRef') != dict(unit_ref)
            or receipt.get('operationRef') != operation_ref
            or receipt.get('inputDigest') != expected_prompt_digest
            or state not in _STATES or type(revision) is not int or revision < 1):
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_RECEIPT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    try:
        encoded = canonical_bytes(_plain_view(receipt), profile=LIBRARY_JSON_PROFILE)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_RECEIPT_NOT_CANONICAL') from exc
    digest = hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
    if len(encoded) > 262144:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_RECEIPT_BOUND_EXCEEDED')
    expected = Digest('sha256', digest)
    blob_ref = blobs.put_verified(encoded, expected, 'application/json')
    if (type(blob_ref) is not BlobRef or blob_ref.digest != expected
            or blob_ref.byte_length != len(encoded) or blob_ref.media_type != 'application/json'
            or blobs.read_verified(blob_ref) != encoded):
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_BLOB_CAPTURE_MISMATCH')
    if getattr(blobs, 'authority_id', None) != authority_id:
        raise ApplicationError('EXECUTION_BLOB_AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
    return ExecutionObservationRef(dict(unit_ref), operation_ref, expected_prompt_digest,
                                   query_digest, state, revision, blob_ref, authority_id)


__all__ = ['capture_execution_observation']

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DeclaredUnitReportBinding:
    document_type: str
    execution_ref: object
    output_refs: tuple


@dataclass(frozen=True)

    method_ref: object
    report_schema_ref: object

    report_content_digest: Digest

class MethodUnitReportSource:
    """Combine original MethodControl, BlobStore and trusted business binding.

    bindings.guard_report_binding resolves the original work/step/attempt and
    author Unit identity, method-declared report type and fixed outputs. It must
    hold current source/authority guards through the caller's COMMIT. No caller
    binding, default role, repository scan or test execution is accepted here.
    """
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, blobs, bindings):
        if (getattr(method_control, 'factory', None) is not factory
                or getattr(blobs, 'authority_id', None) != factory.authority_id
                or bindings is None or getattr(bindings, 'factory', None) is not factory):
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory, self.methods, self.blobs, self.bindings = factory, method_control, blobs, bindings

    @contextmanager
    def guard_report(self, context, package, submission, captured):
        method = package.payload.method_ref
        with self.methods.guard_selected(context) as snapshot:
            selected = snapshot.ref
            if (selected.method_id, selected.release_version, selected.schema_version,
                    selected.snapshot_digest) != (method.method_id, method.release_version,
                    method.schema_version, method.snapshot_digest.hex):
                raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_METHOD_MISMATCH')
            with self.bindings.guard_report_binding(context, snapshot, package, submission) as binding:
                if (type(binding) is not DeclaredUnitReportBinding
                        or binding.execution_ref != submission.execution_ref
                        or binding.output_refs != submission.output_refs):
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                content = submission.method_content
                spec = document_spec(snapshot, binding.document_type)
                exact = content.schema_ref
                resources = [r for r in snapshot.resources if r.resource_id == exact.resource_id]
                if (exact.method_ref != method or len(resources) != 1
                        or resources[0].logical_path != exact.logical_path
                        or resources[0].digest != exact.resource_digest.hex
                        or spec.schema_ref.resource_id != exact.resource_id
                        or spec.schema_ref.sha256 != exact.resource_digest.hex):
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH')
                valid = validate_document_content(snapshot, binding.document_type, {'value': content.value})
                if not valid.ok:
                    raise ApplicationError(valid.error.code)
                receipt = decode_json(self.blobs.read_verified(captured.blob_ref))
                summary = receipt.get('summary')
                if (captured.state != 'completed' or receipt.get('state') != 'completed'
                        or type(summary) is not dict or summary.get('successfulRpcResponse') is not True
                        or type(summary.get('text')) is not str):
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE')
                try:
                    reported = decode_json(summary['text'].encode('utf-8'))
                    raw = canonical_bytes(reported)
                except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_OUTPUT_INVALID') from None
                if raw != content.value_bytes:
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_OUTPUT_MISMATCH')
                yield VerifiedUnitReport(method, exact, binding.output_refs,
                    Digest('sha256', hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()),
                    submission.execution_ref.operation_ref, submission.execution_ref.prompt_input_digest,
                    captured.query_digest, captured.blob_ref)

        raw=encode_submission(record)
        schema=report_input_schema()
        digest=request_digest(operation,context,{'record':decode_json(raw)},read_set_projection(ReadSet(context.scope,())),
            input_schema_id=schema['$id'],input_schema_digest=Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(schema)).hexdigest()),interface_version='1')
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            entry=uow.commands.get(context.key)
            if entry is not None:
                if entry.operation != operation or entry.request_digest != digest or entry.project_id != context.scope.project_id:
                    raise ApplicationError('REQUEST_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
                return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,entry.state,entry.result_bytes)
        execution=record.execution_ref
        unit_ref={'environmentNamespace':execution.environment_namespace,'unitId':execution.unit_id,
            'ownerProviderRef':decode_json(execution.owner_provider_ref_bytes),'sourceRevision':execution.source_revision}
        captured=capture_execution_observation(records,blobs,authority_id=self.factory.authority_id,
            unit_ref=unit_ref,operation_ref=execution.operation_ref,
            expected_prompt_digest='sha256:'+execution.prompt_input_digest.hex,query_invocation=query_invocation)
        if captured.blob_ref.identity_projection() != execution.captured_observation_ref.identity_projection():
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_CHANGED')
        if self.approvals is None:
            raise ApplicationError('IMPLEMENTATION_GRANT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        try:
            with ExitStack() as guards:
                with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
                    package=uow.implementation.resolve_package(record.package_ref)
                    grant=uow.authorization.get_grant(record.authorization_refs[0])
                admission_port=self.approvals._admission()
                guards.enter_context(admission_port.guard_intent(context,grant.intent))
                guards.enter_context(admission_port.guard_evidence(context,grant.intent,grant.evidence))
                decisions=guards.enter_context(self.approvals._gates(context,grant.intent))
                admission=guards.enter_context(self.report_source.guard_report(context,package,record,captured))
                self._validate_report_admission(record,package,captured,admission)
                return self._commit_report(record,context,digest,decisions=decisions)
        except ReferenceError as exc:
            raise ApplicationError(exc.code) from exc

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_report_admission(record,package,captured,admission):
        if (admission is None or record.method_content.schema_ref != admission.report_schema_ref
                or record.method_content.schema_ref.method_ref != admission.method_ref
                or package.payload.method_ref != admission.method_ref
                or hashlib.sha256(record.method_content.value_bytes).hexdigest() != admission.report_content_digest.hex
                or record.output_refs != admission.output_refs
                or admission.execution_operation_ref != record.execution_ref.operation_ref
                or admission.prompt_input_digest != record.execution_ref.prompt_input_digest
                or admission.query_digest != captured.query_digest
                or admission.captured_observation_ref != captured.blob_ref):
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        covered=tuple(ref for item in record.coverage for ref in item.output_refs)
        if set(covered) != set(record.output_refs):
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_REPORT_OUTPUT_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE')

    def _commit_report(self,record,context,digest,*,decisions):
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope) as uow:
            reservation=uow.commands.reserve(context.key,project_id=context.scope.project_id,
                operation='engineering.submissions.record_report',operation_id=str(uuid4()),request_digest=digest)
            entry=reservation.entry
            if not reservation.created:
                return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,entry.state,entry.result_bytes)
            package=uow.implementation.resolve_package(record.package_ref)
            grant=uow.authorization.get_grant(record.authorization_refs[0])
            from ..support.clock import utc_now
            ImplementationUseCases._resolve_package(uow,package,now=utc_now())
            self.approvals._check_gates(uow,decisions)
            from ...orchestration.steps.implementation_dispatch import resolve_dispatch_submission_binding
            resolve_dispatch_submission_binding(uow,record)
            before=tuple(uow.implementation.resolve_repository_baseline(r) for r in record.baseline_snapshots)
            validate_submission_graph(record,package,grant,before,())
            for ref in self._blobs(record):
                uow.implementation.read_blob(ref)
            for ref in record.output_refs:
                uow.engineering.resolve_revision(ref)
            verify_sources(record.source_refs,(),uow.proposals.validated_budget())
            ref=uow.submissions.create(record)
            result=canonical_bytes({'submission_ref':asdict(ref),'workflow_state':'submitted',
                'review_status':'pending_review','accepted':False})
            uow.commands.complete(context.key,state='completed',result_bytes=result,expected_version=entry.version)
            uow.commit()
            return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,'completed',result)

    def record(self, record, context, *, records, blobs, query_invocation):
        operation='engineering.submissions.record'
        if type(context) is not CommandContext or self.access is None:
            raise ApplicationError('ACCESS_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        self.access.require(context,operation)
        if (type(record) is not Submission or record.scope != context.scope
                or record.created_by != context.authenticated_actor or record.created_at != context.received_at):
            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH')
        raw=encode_submission(record)
        schema='urn:ordessa:engineering:submission-record:1'
        digest=request_digest(operation,context,{'record_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},[],
            input_schema_id=schema,input_schema_digest=Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(schema.encode()).hexdigest()),interface_version='1')
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            entry=uow.commands.get(context.key)
            if entry is not None:
                if entry.operation != operation or entry.request_digest != digest or entry.project_id != context.scope.project_id:
                    raise ApplicationError('REQUEST_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
                return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,entry.state,entry.result_bytes)
        execution=record.execution_ref
        unit_ref={'environmentNamespace':execution.environment_namespace,'unitId':execution.unit_id,
            'ownerProviderRef':decode_json(execution.owner_provider_ref_bytes),'sourceRevision':execution.source_revision}
        # Original Records authorization and full capture happen outside TX.
        captured=capture_execution_observation(records,blobs,authority_id=self.factory.authority_id,
            unit_ref=unit_ref,operation_ref=execution.operation_ref,
            expected_prompt_digest='sha256:'+execution.prompt_input_digest.hex,query_invocation=query_invocation)
        try:
            with ExitStack() as guards:
                if captured.blob_ref.identity_projection() != execution.captured_observation_ref.identity_projection():
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_CHANGED')
                if self.approvals is None:
                    raise ApplicationError('IMPLEMENTATION_GRANT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
                if self.source is None:
                    raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_DISPATCH_BINDING_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
                with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
                    try:
                        package=uow.implementation.resolve_package(record.package_ref)
                        grant=uow.authorization.get_grant(record.authorization_refs[0])
                    except ApplicationError as exc:
                        if exc.code == 'NOT_FOUND':
                            raise ApplicationError('SUBMISSION_BINDING_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE') from exc
                        raise
                admission=self.approvals._admission()
                guards.enter_context(admission.guard_intent(context,grant.intent))
                guards.enter_context(admission.guard_evidence(context,grant.intent,grant.evidence))
                decisions=guards.enter_context(self.approvals._gates(context,grant.intent))
                guards.enter_context(self.source.guard_submission(context,record,package))
                return self._commit(record,context,digest,decisions=decisions)
        except ApplicationError as exc:
            # Unauthorized capture/access is never converted to a successful
            # command. Preserve only admitted observation/binding refusals.
            if not exc.code.startswith(('SUBMISSION_','IMPLEMENTATION_','PACKAGE_','METHOD_','REVIEW_','AUTHORIZATION_','CONSENT_','ACTION_','DISPATCH_')):
                raise
            return self._quarantine(record,context,digest,captured,blobs,exc.code)
        except ReferenceError as exc:
            return self._quarantine(record,context,digest,captured,blobs,exc.code)

    def _commit(self,record,context,digest,*,decisions):
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope) as uow:
            reservation=uow.commands.reserve(context.key,project_id=context.scope.project_id,
                operation='engineering.submissions.record',operation_id=str(uuid4()),request_digest=digest)
            entry=reservation.entry
            if not reservation.created:
                return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,entry.state,entry.result_bytes)
            package=uow.implementation.resolve_package(record.package_ref)
            grant=uow.authorization.get_grant(record.authorization_refs[0])
            ImplementationUseCases._resolve_package(uow,package,now=context.received_at)
            self.approvals._check_gates(uow,decisions)
            from ...orchestration.steps.implementation_dispatch import resolve_dispatch_submission_binding
            resolve_dispatch_submission_binding(uow,record)
            before=tuple(uow.implementation.resolve_repository_baseline(r) for r in record.baseline_snapshots)
            after=tuple(uow.implementation.resolve_repository_baseline(r) for r in record.resulting_snapshots)
            validate_submission_graph(record,package,grant,before,after)
            for ref in self._blobs(record):
                uow.implementation.read_blob(ref)
            for ref in record.output_refs + tuple(r for c in record.coverage for r in c.evidence_refs):
                if type(ref) is ArtifactRevisionRef:
                    uow.engineering.resolve_revision(ref)
            budget=uow.proposals.validated_budget()
            verify_sources(record.source_refs,(),budget)
            ref=uow.submissions.create(record)
            result=canonical_bytes({'submission_ref':asdict(ref),'accepted':False})
            uow.commands.complete(context.key,state='completed',result_bytes=result,expected_version=entry.version)
            uow.commit()
            return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,'completed',result)

    @staticmethod
    def _blobs(record):
        return tuple({r for r in (record.execution_ref.captured_observation_ref,record.checkpoint_ref,
            None if record.method_content is None else record.method_content.rendered_body_ref,
            *(r for r in record.output_refs if type(r) is BlobRef),
            *(r for c in record.coverage for r in c.evidence_refs if type(r) is BlobRef),
            *(t.observation_ref for t in record.test_evidence),
            *(t.execution_ref.captured_observation_ref for t in record.test_evidence),
            *(r for e in record.effect_observations for r in e.evidence_refs),
            *(e.compensation_ref for e in record.effect_observations)) if r is not None})

    def _quarantine(self,record,context,digest,captured,blobs,reason):
        raw=encode_submission(record)
        draft=blobs.put_verified(raw,Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()),'application/json')
        envelope=canonical_bytes({'contract':'ordessa.quarantined-submission-draft/1',
            'reason':reason,'draft_ref':asdict(draft),'execution_observation_ref':asdict(captured.blob_ref),
            'claimed_submission_ref':asdict(record.ref),'normal_submission_sealed':False})
        anomaly=blobs.put_verified(envelope,Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(envelope).hexdigest()),'application/json')
        sources=tuple(SourceRef('capture-'+str(i),'tool_observation',
            SourceLocator('tool_observation',provider='engineering-submission-capture',observation_id=record.execution_ref.operation_ref),
            ExcerptCapture(ref,ref.digest,ContentSelector('whole_capture')),context.received_at,
            context.authenticated_actor,ref.media_type,ref.byte_length) for i,ref in enumerate((draft,captured.blob_ref)))
        # Original Artifact owner validates all captured blobs/sources in its
        # own same-write-UoW budget. Blob puts above are not business-TX atomic.
        value={'kind':'other','initial':{'media_type':'application/json',
            'schema_id':'urn:ordessa:quarantined-submission-draft:1','blob_ref':asdict(anomaly)},
            'sources':[asdict(s) for s in sources]}
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope) as uow:
            reservation=uow.commands.reserve(context.key,project_id=context.scope.project_id,
                operation='engineering.submissions.record',operation_id=str(uuid4()),request_digest=digest)
            entry=reservation.entry
            if not reservation.created:
                return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,entry.state,entry.result_bytes)
            facts=ArtifactUseCases._mutate(uow,'engineering.artifacts.create',value,context)
            result=canonical_bytes({'state':'quarantined','reason':reason,'quarantined_submission_draft_ref':facts['revision_ref'],
                'execution_observation_ref':asdict(captured.blob_ref),'normal_submission_sealed':False})
            uow.commands.complete(context.key,state='completed',result_bytes=result,expected_version=entry.version)
            uow.commit()
            return CommandResult(uow.authority_id,entry.operation_id,'completed',result)

from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from ordessa_infrastructure.encoding import canonical_bytes
from ...contracts.errors import ApplicationError

def _requirements(values):
    return sorted(canonical_bytes(asdict(value)) for value in values)


def resolve_implementation_intent(uow, intent):
    """No captured intent or caller requirement list is itself permission."""
    if type(intent) is not ImplementationAuthorizationIntent or intent.scope != uow.scope:
        raise ApplicationError('ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED')
    uow.authorization.require_implementation_authorization_schema()
    budget = uow.proposals.validated_budget()
    proposals = tuple(uow.proposals.get_proposal(ref, budget) for ref in intent.change_set.proposal_refs)
    controls = tuple(uow.proposals.get_control(p.ref, budget) for p in proposals)
    if (ChangeSet(tuple(p.ref for p in proposals)) != intent.change_set
            or any(c.disposition != 'available' for c in controls)
            or any(p.method_ref != intent.method_ref or p.implementation_intent != intent.implementation_spec
                   for p in proposals)):
        raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    targets = tuple(m.proposed_ref for p in proposals for m in p.mutations)
    if len(targets) != len(set(targets)) or set(targets) != set(intent.targets):
        raise ApplicationError('CONSENT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    requirements = tuple(r for p in proposals for r in resolve_record(p, uow.proposals, budget))
    if _requirements(requirements) != _requirements(intent.required_review_requirements):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    for ref in intent.implementation_spec.expected_baselines:
        uow.proposals.resolve_repository_baseline(ref, budget)
    for ref in intent.supporting_review_refs:
        controlled = uow.reviews.get_review(ref)
        if controlled.control.state != 'active' or controlled.record.plan.requirement not in requirements:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_STALE')
    return proposals, controls, requirements


class ImplementationIntentAdmission:
    """Configured original business bindings and current method guard span COMMIT.

    Conversation admission still attests the actual configured user Q&A. This
    guard neither manufactures that Q&A nor upgrades a DID/apply grant.
    """
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, bindings):
        if getattr(method_control, 'factory', None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory, self.methods, self.bindings = factory, method_control, bindings
        self.bridge = MethodBridge()

    @contextmanager
    def guard_intent(self, context, intent):
        if type(intent) is not ImplementationAuthorizationIntent or intent.scope != context.scope:
            raise ApplicationError('INTENT_OWNER_UNAVAILABLE')
        resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_intent_bindings', None)
        if not callable(resolver):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_TARGET_BINDINGS_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context, intent.method_ref) as snapshot:
            resolved = tuple((ref, resolver(context, intent.method_ref, ref))
                             for ref in intent.change_set.proposal_refs)
            complete = []
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope, 'read') as uow:
                resolve_implementation_intent(uow, intent)
                budget = uow.proposals.validated_budget()
                for ref, phases in resolved:
                    if (type(phases) is not tuple or not phases
                            or any(type(b) is not EngineeringTargetBindings or b.scope != context.scope for b in phases)
                            or len({b.phase_key for b in phases}) != len(phases)):
                        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                    for phase in phases:
                        self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, phase)
                    proposal = uow.proposals.get_proposal(ref, budget)
                    roots = tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in proposal.mutations)
                    roots += tuple(m.base_ref for m in proposal.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)
                    roots += tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for c in proposal.claim_refs)
                    revisions = uow.proposals.resolve_revision_graph(roots, budget)
                    owners = tuple(replace(uow.engineering.get_artifact(m.artifact_id), head_revision_id=None)
                                   for m in proposal.mutations)
                    complete.extend(self.bridge.proposal_review_requirements(snapshot, phases,
                        proposal=proposal, artifacts=owners, revisions=revisions))
                if _requirements(complete) != _requirements(intent.required_review_requirements):
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
            yield

"""Application proposal-closure coordination.

The adapter implements the reads (``ProposalReadPort``: canonical decode of a
proposal record, revision-graph resolution, artifact-owner selection) and the
writes/CAS. This module owns the closure orchestration and the business
validation: the application calls ``verify_sources`` and the domain
``validate_proposal`` here, on the caller's per-operation budget (same UoW /
readset / content binding).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace

from ..contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ..contracts.access import proposal_validation_key
from ..contracts.repositories import ProposalReadPort
from .material_closure import verify_sources
from ...domain.changes.operations import validate_proposal

PROPOSAL_LIMIT = 4096
ANCESTRY_LIMIT = 10000


def resolve_record(record, reader: ProposalReadPort, budget, *, creating=False):
    """Validate one proposal record against its exact resolved values."""
    if record.implementation_intent is not None:
        # Only an exact baseline in the original same-UoW owner can resolve.
        resolve_baseline = getattr(reader, 'resolve_repository_baseline', None)
        if resolve_baseline is None:
            raise ApplicationError('IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        for ref in record.implementation_intent.expected_baselines:
            resolve_baseline(ref, budget)
    verify_sources(record.basis_sources, record.evidence_links, budget)
    budget.method(record.method_ref)
    for template in record.review_requirement_templates:
        budget.method(template.method_ref)
    roots = (tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in record.mutations)
             + tuple(m.base_ref for m in record.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)
             + tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for c in record.claim_refs))
    revisions = reader.resolve_revision_graph(roots, budget)
    owners = tuple(reader.select_artifact(record.scope, m.artifact_id) for m in record.mutations)
    if any(owner is None for owner in owners):
        raise ApplicationError('NOT_FOUND')
    # The proposal records a create request, even after a later apply adopts its
    # head. Current head eligibility is checked only while creating/applying.
    if not creating:
        owners = tuple(replace(owner, head_revision_id=None) for owner in owners)
    return validate_proposal(record, owners, revisions)


def coordinate_closure(record, reader: ProposalReadPort, budget, *, creating=False):
    """Walk the supersession closure, validating each record on one budget."""
    pending = [record]
    seen = set()
    validated = {}
    edges = 0
    requirements = ()
    while pending:
        value = pending.pop()
        if value.ref in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(value.ref)
        if len(seen) > PROPOSAL_LIMIT:
            raise ApplicationError('PROPOSAL_LIMIT')
        current = resolve_record(value, reader, budget, creating=creating and value.ref == record.ref)
        if value.ref == record.ref:
            requirements = current
        validated[value.ref] = value
        edges += len(value.supersedes_refs)
        if edges > ANCESTRY_LIMIT:
            raise ApplicationError('PROPOSAL_LIMIT')
        pending.extend(reader.read_proposal(ref, budget) for ref in value.supersedes_refs)
    return requirements, validated


def validate_create(record, reader: ProposalReadPort, budget):
    """Application-triggered create validation; binds the result on the budget.

    Marks the budget and binds the returned requirements under the same
    per-operation key, so ``create_proposal`` can consume exactly the validated
    result instead of an arbitrary argument.
    """
    requirements, _ = coordinate_closure(record, reader, budget, creating=True)
    key = proposal_validation_key(record)
    budget.mark_validated(key)
    budget.bind_validated_result(key, requirements)
    return requirements


__all__ = ['resolve_record', 'coordinate_closure', 'validate_create']

This is business coordination over the pure method kernels: rebuild the source
projection, verify compiled identity, read the injected capability catalog,
validate compatibility, prepare blobs and atomically publish the snapshot. It
holds no method *interpretation* (that stays in ``methods``) and no storage
