def _checked_blob(store: SnapshotStore, digest: str, media_type: str, data: bytes) -> BlobRef:
    ref = store.put_blob(digest, media_type, data)
    if not isinstance(ref, BlobRef):
        raise MethodFailure(MethodError("SNAPSHOT_STORE_INVALID", "blob store returned an invalid BlobRef"))
    if ref.digest != digest or ref.byte_length != len(data) or ref.media_type != media_type or not ref.storage_object_id:
        raise MethodFailure(MethodError("SNAPSHOT_STORE_INVALID", "blob store returned mismatched content metadata"))
    return ref


def freeze_method(compiled: CompiledMethod, store: SnapshotStore,
                  existing: ReleasedIdentityIndex, *,
                  capability_catalog: CapabilityCatalogReader | None = None) -> MethodResult[FreezeResult]:
    if capability_catalog is None:
        return MethodResult.failure(MethodError(
            "CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE",
            "method publication requires an application-injected capability catalog reader",
        ))
    try:
        # Capture references before invoking any injected port. The verified
        # values below are rebuilt from immutable bytes and detached containers.
        source_bundle = compiled.source_bundle
        compiled_identity = compiled.identity
        compiled_manifest_digest = compiled.source_manifest_digest
        compiler_version = compiled.compiler_version
        compiled_plan_digest = program_plan_digest(compiled.program)
        frozen_envelope = compiled.program
        source_manifest_bytes = bytes(source_bundle.manifest_bytes)
        parsed_source = rebuild_source_bundle(source_bundle)
        if compiled.parsed_source != parsed_source:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError("COMPILED_SOURCE_PROJECTION_MISMATCH", "compiled parsed view differs from captured bytes"))
        manifest, identity = parsed_source.manifest, parsed_source.identity
        source_resources, manifest_digest = parsed_source.resource_views, source_bundle.manifest_digest
        if manifest_digest != compiled_manifest_digest or identity != compiled_identity:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError("COMPILED_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", "compiled method identity no longer matches captured source bytes"))
        program = program_to_canonical(frozen_envelope)
        if (frozen_envelope.compiler_version != compiler_version
                or program.get("compiler_version") != compiler_version
                or program_plan_digest(frozen_envelope) != compiled_plan_digest):
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError("COMPILED_PLAN_METADATA_MISMATCH", "compiled program metadata does not match its frozen envelope"))
        if method_digest("compiled-method-program", program) != compiled_plan_digest:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError("COMPILED_PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "compiled program no longer matches its digest"))
        source_loaded = LoadedMethod(MethodSource(Path(".")), source_bundle, parsed_source)
        expected_program = compile_program_from_source(source_loaded, compiler_version)
        if expected_program != program or compiled.program.bindings != bind_program(stored_program_from_canonical(expected_program), source_loaded).bindings:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError(
                "COMPILED_PROGRAM_SOURCE_MISMATCH",
                "compiled program projection does not match the captured source bytes",
            ))

        catalog = capability_catalog.read_current()
        if catalog.trust_class != "host":
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError(
                "CAPABILITY_CATALOG_UNTRUSTED",
                "fixture or unknown capability catalogs cannot publish a method release",
            ))
        report = validate_compatibility(source_loaded, catalog)
        if not report.valid:
            first_error = next(item for item in report.diagnostics if item.severity == "error")
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError(first_error.code, first_error.message,
                                            first_error.resource_id, first_error.path,
                                            first_error.pointer))

        # Freeze every projection used below before the first store call. Store
        # callbacks may re-enter application code and mutate the caller's
        # CompiledMethod while blobs are being written.
        prepared_resources: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, bytes]] = []
        for resource in sorted(source_resources.values(),
                               key=lambda item: item.declaration["id"]):
            raw = bytes(resource.captured.data)
            digest = resource.captured.digest
            if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != digest:
                raise MethodFailure(MethodError("RESOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "captured resource bytes changed", resource_id=resource.declaration["id"], path=resource.captured.logical_path))
            if resource.declaration.get("sha256") != digest:
                raise MethodFailure(MethodError("RESOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "compiled source declaration does not bind captured resource bytes", resource_id=resource.declaration["id"], path=resource.captured.logical_path))
            prepared_resources.append((
                resource.declaration["id"], resource.captured.logical_path,
                resource.captured.media_type, digest, raw,
            ))
        resource_projection = [
            {"id": resource_id, "sha256": digest}
            for resource_id, _, _, digest, _ in prepared_resources
        ]
        required_capabilities = deepcopy(program["capability_bindings"])
        snapshot_identity = identity
        snapshot_digest = method_digest("method-snapshot", {
            "schema_version": identity.schema_version,
            "method_id": identity.method_id,
            "release_version": identity.release_version,
            "manifest_sha256": manifest_digest,
            "resource_digests": resource_projection,
            "required_capabilities": required_capabilities,
            "compiler_version": compiler_version,
            "compiled_plan_digest": {"algorithm": "sha256", "hex": compiled_plan_digest},
        })
        expected_ref = MethodRef(identity.method_id, identity.release_version,
                                 identity.schema_version, snapshot_digest)
        existing_digest = existing.get_digest(identity.method_id, identity.release_version)
        if existing_digest is not None and existing_digest != snapshot_digest:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError(
                "RELEASE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT",
                "method ID and release version are already bound to different snapshot bytes",
            ))

        resource_snapshots: list[ResourceSnapshot] = []
        for resource_id, logical_path, media_type, digest, raw in prepared_resources:
            blob_ref = _checked_blob(store, digest, media_type, raw)
            resource_snapshots.append(ResourceSnapshot(resource_id, logical_path, blob_ref))

        manifest_ref = _checked_blob(
            store, manifest_digest, "application/yaml",
            source_manifest_bytes,
        )
        snapshot = MethodSnapshot(StoredSourceBundle(snapshot_identity, manifest_ref, tuple(resource_snapshots)), bind_program(stored_program_from_canonical(program), source_loaded), snapshot_digest)

        # This is the authority boundary: the store must atomically enforce the
        # release identity binding. The preflight index is only an optimization.
        published_ref = store.publish(snapshot)
        if published_ref != expected_ref:
            raise MethodFailure(MethodError("SNAPSHOT_PUBLISH_MISMATCH", "snapshot store published a different release identity"))
        # Do not expose the object handed to a memory adapter: callers may hold
        # and mutate result values even though the protocol models immutable data.
        return MethodResult.success(FreezeResult(snapshot=deepcopy(snapshot)))
    except MethodFailure as exc:
        return MethodResult.failure(exc.error)
    except (AttributeError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return MethodResult.failure(MethodError("METHOD_FREEZE_FAILED", "method snapshot could not be frozen safely"))

"""Recover the original command result without dispatch or replaying effects.

Pending is an observation, not permission to take over a worker. Work/Step and
outbox recovery require their missing durable claim and reconciliation ports.
"""
from ordessa_engineering.application.contracts.commands import CommandContext, CommandKey, CommandResult
from ordessa_engineering.application.contracts.errors import ApplicationError


def read_command(uow, context, request_id):
    if type(context) is not CommandContext:
        raise ApplicationError("INVALID_CONTEXT")
    if context.scope != uow.scope:
        raise ApplicationError("SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    # Preserve the original authenticated context object. A target request id
    # never substitutes a principal, project or capability admission.
    key = CommandKey(context.scope.realm_id, context.principal_id, request_id)
    entry = uow.commands.get(key)
    if entry is None:
        raise ApplicationError("COMMAND_NOT_FOUND")
    return CommandResult(uow.authority_id, entry.operation_id,
                         entry.state, entry.result_bytes)

Only condition advancement is coordinated here. Operations and external effects
remain explicit calls to original owners, with their own admission/write cuts.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import asdict, fields
from ...contracts.errors import ApplicationError
from ...contracts.method_work import WORK_CONTRACT, WAIT_EVENT, WorkSeed, WorkWaitSelection, BoundWorkWait

def _copy(value):
    return canonical_value(canonical_bytes(value))


class CurrentMethodWorkBindings:
    """Actual selected method + current Work source + original run identity."""
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, source, registry_loader):
        if getattr(method_control,'factory',None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory,self.methods,self.source,self.registry_loader=factory,method_control,source,registry_loader

    @staticmethod
    def _inputs(context,row):
        value=row['inputs']
        if (type(value) is not dict or set(value) != {'work_contract','scope','method_ref','compiled_plan_digest','slots'}
                or value['work_contract'] != WORK_CONTRACT or value['scope'] != asdict(context.scope)
                or type(value['slots']) is not dict):
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
        try:
            return decode_method_ref(value['method_ref'])
        except (ReferenceError,TypeError,ValueError):
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID') from None

    @staticmethod
    def _program(snapshot):
        program=snapshot.program
        if type(program) is not CompiledProgram or program.workflow.resume_contract != WORK_CONTRACT:
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_RESUME_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE')
        return program

    @contextmanager
    def guard_wait(self,context,run_id,row):
        if self.source is None or self.registry_loader is None:
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_WAIT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        method=self._inputs(context,row)
        with self.methods.guard_method(context,method) as snapshot:
            program=self._program(snapshot)
            if row['inputs']['compiled_plan_digest'] != program_plan_digest(program):
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
            if row['registry_ref'] != registry_ref(self.registry_loader()):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_CAPABILITY_CHANGED')
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
                marker=uow.workflow.read(row['method_ref'])
                if marker != {k:v for k,v in row['inputs'].items() if k != 'slots'}:
                    raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
                ordinal=uow.workflow.next_step_ordinal(run_id)
            cursor=row['cursor']
            if type(cursor) is not int or not 0 <= cursor < len(program.workflow.steps):
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_CURSOR_INVALID')
            node=program.workflow.steps[cursor]
            if type(node) is not WaitNode or node.event != WAIT_EVENT or row['wait_reason'] != node.id:
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_WAIT_UNAVAILABLE')
            with self.source.guard_condition(context,snapshot,node,{'run_id':run_id,'row':_copy({**row,'method_ref':asdict(row['method_ref'])}), 'row_digest':run_wait_row_digest(row),'next_step_ordinal':ordinal}) as selected:
                if type(selected) is not WorkWaitSelection:
                    raise ApplicationError('WORK_CONDITION_INVALID')
                condition=selected.condition
                if (condition.scope != context.scope or condition.run_id != run_id
                        or condition.row_digest != run_wait_row_digest(row) or condition.next_step_ordinal != ordinal):
                    raise ApplicationError('RUN_WAIT_CHANGED')
                if condition.intent is not None and any(r.method_ref != method
                        for r in condition.intent.required_review_requirements):
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
                values=_copy(selected.event_values)
                # Match is equality of exact current-owner identities, not text
                # interpreted as user confirmation or an authorization boolean.
                for binding in (() if node.match is None else node.match.entries):
                    if binding.name not in values or binding.slot not in row['inputs']['slots']:
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_EVENT_INCOMPLETE')
                    if values[binding.name] != row['inputs']['slots'][binding.slot]:
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_EVENT_MISMATCH')
                updates=[]
                for binding in (() if node.bind is None else node.bind.entries):
                    if not binding.slot.startswith('event.') or binding.slot[6:] not in values:
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_EVENT_INCOMPLETE')
                    if binding.name not in (program.workflow.context_slots or ()):
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_EVENT_INVALID')
                    updates.append((binding.name,values[binding.slot[6:]]))
                destinations=[i for i,n in enumerate(program.workflow.steps) if n.id==node.next]
                if len(destinations)!=1:
                    raise ApplicationError('WORK_CURSOR_INVALID')
                next_cursor=destinations[0]; target=program.workflow.steps[next_cursor]
                status='WAITING_FOR_CONDITION' if type(target) is WaitNode else 'SLICE_DONE' if type(target) is StopNode else 'RUNNING'
                yield BoundWorkWait(**{f.name:getattr(condition,f.name) for f in fields(condition)}, next_cursor=next_cursor,next_status=status,
                    next_wait_reason=target.id if type(target) is WaitNode else None,slot_updates=tuple(updates))


class CurrentMethodWorkUseCases(ApprovalUseCases):
    def __init__(self,factory,access,bindings):
        super().__init__(factory,access)
        if bindings is not None and (type(bindings) is not CurrentMethodWorkBindings or bindings.factory is not factory):
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.bindings=bindings

    @staticmethod
    def claim_current_wait(tx, run_id, *, expected_row_digest, expected_next_step_ordinal,
                           now, next_cursor=None, next_inputs=None,
                           next_status="RUNNING", next_wait_reason=None):
        """CAS the current method Work against the original run and step log."""
        row = tx.run_row(run_id)
        if (run_wait_row_digest(row) != expected_row_digest
                or tx.next_step_ordinal(run_id) != expected_next_step_ordinal):
            raise ApplicationError('RUN_WAIT_CHANGED')
        if not row['status'].startswith('WAITING_FOR_'):
            raise ApplicationError('RUN_NOT_WAITING')
        if next_inputs is not None:
            tx.replace_run_inputs(run_id=run_id, expected_inputs=row['inputs'], inputs=next_inputs)
        tx.update_run(run_id=run_id, status=next_status, cursor=next_cursor,
                      wait_reason=next_wait_reason, now=now)

    def read(self,parameters,context):
        from ...contracts.commands import CommandContext
        if type(context) is not CommandContext:
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_CONTEXT')
        if self.access is None:
            raise ApplicationError('ACCESS_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        self.access.require(context,'engineering.work.get')
        try:
            require_object(parameters,{'run_id'},'INVALID_INPUT'); validate_id(parameters['run_id'])
        except (ReferenceError,TypeError,ValueError):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from None
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            row=uow.workflow.run_row(parameters['run_id'])
            CurrentMethodWorkBindings._inputs(context,row)
            marker=uow.workflow.read(row['method_ref'])
            if marker != {k:v for k,v in row['inputs'].items() if k != 'slots'}:
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
            return {**row,'method_ref':asdict(row['method_ref']),
                'next_step_ordinal':uow.workflow.next_step_ordinal(parameters['run_id'])}

    def record_command_step(self,parameters,context,*,read_set=None):
        """Consume an actual original journal result; never dispatch or retry."""
        from ...contracts.commands import CommandKey, ReadSet, request_digest, read_set_projection, artifact_read_set_projection
        from ...orchestration.method_bridge import MethodBridge
        from ....methods.definitions.models.compiled import OperationNode
        from ....domain.common.models.values import Digest
        import hashlib
        op='engineering.work.record_command_step'
        value,reads,digest=self._input(op,parameters,context,read_set)
        try:
            validate_id(value['run_id']); validate_id(value['operation_request_id'])
            expected=Digest(**value['expected_row_digest'])
        except (ReferenceError,TypeError,ValueError):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from None
        replay=self._replay(op,context,digest)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        binding=self.bindings
        if binding is None or binding.source is None:
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_WAIT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            row=uow.workflow.run_row(value['run_id'])
        method=binding._inputs(context,row)
        with binding.methods.guard_method(context,method) as snapshot:
            program=binding._program(snapshot)
            if binding.registry_loader is None or row['registry_ref']!=registry_ref(binding.registry_loader()):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_CAPABILITY_CHANGED')
            if row['inputs']['compiled_plan_digest']!=program_plan_digest(program):
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
            cursor=row['cursor']
            if (row['status']!='RUNNING' or type(cursor) is not int
                    or not 0<=cursor<len(program.workflow.steps)
                    or type(program.workflow.steps[cursor]) is not OperationNode):
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE')
            node=program.workflow.steps[cursor]
            # Ordinary Facade commands only. External dispatch has its own
            # durable outcome owner and cannot be replaced by a journal guess.
            params=MethodBridge().operation_inputs(program,node.id,row['inputs']['slots'])
            source_guard=getattr(binding.source,'guard_step_completion',None)
            if not callable(source_guard):
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_COMPLETION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE')
            with source_guard(context,snapshot,node,{'run_id':value['run_id'],'row':row}) as invocation_reads:
                if type(invocation_reads) is not ReadSet or invocation_reads.scope!=context.scope:
                    raise ApplicationError('WORK_COMPLETION_SOURCE_INVALID')
                from ...api import EngineeringService
                schema=EngineeringService.input_schema(node.operation)
                projection=artifact_read_set_projection(invocation_reads) if node.operation.startswith('engineering.artifacts.') else read_set_projection(invocation_reads)
                expected_command=request_digest(node.operation,context,params,projection,
                    input_schema_id=schema['$id'],input_schema_digest=Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(schema)).hexdigest()),
                    interface_version=schema['$id'].rsplit(':',1)[1])
                def mutate(uow):
                    current=uow.workflow.run_row(value['run_id'])
                    if (run_wait_row_digest(current)!=expected or current!=row
                            or uow.workflow.next_step_ordinal(value['run_id'])!=value['expected_next_step_ordinal']):
                        raise ApplicationError('RUN_WAIT_CHANGED')
                    if uow.workflow.read(current['method_ref']) != {k:v for k,v in current['inputs'].items() if k!='slots'}:
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_BINDING_INVALID')
                    entry=uow.commands.get(CommandKey(context.scope.realm_id,context.principal_id,value['operation_request_id']))
                    if (entry is None or entry.operation!=node.operation or entry.project_id!=context.scope.project_id
                            or entry.request_digest!=expected_command):
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_COMMAND_RESULT_MISMATCH')
                    if entry.state not in ('completed','rejected'):
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_OPERATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')
                    transitions=[t.target for t in node.outcomes.entries if t.outcome==entry.state]
                    if len(transitions)!=1 or transitions[0].wait is not None:
                        raise ApplicationError('WORK_TRANSITION_UNAVAILABLE')
                    stopped=transitions[0].stop
                    if stopped is not None:
                        if stopped not in program.workflow.stop_outcomes:
                            raise ApplicationError('WORK_TRANSITION_UNAVAILABLE')
                        destinations=[cursor]; target=None; status='SLICE_DONE'
                    else:
                        destinations=[i for i,n in enumerate(program.workflow.steps) if n.id==transitions[0].next]
                        if len(destinations)!=1:
                            raise ApplicationError('WORK_CURSOR_INVALID')
                        target=program.workflow.steps[destinations[0]]
                        status='WAITING_FOR_CONDITION' if type(target) is WaitNode else 'SLICE_DONE' if type(target) is StopNode else 'RUNNING'
                    ordinal=value['expected_next_step_ordinal']; now=utc_now()
                    receipt=uow.workflow.create_generated(kind='step-receipt',stable_id=f"{value['run_id']}-{ordinal}",body={
                        'schema_version':'engineering-method-step-receipt/1','scope':asdict(context.scope),
                        'run_id':value['run_id'],'ordinal':ordinal,'step_id':node.id,'operation':node.operation,
                        'method_ref':asdict(method),'compiled_plan_digest':program_plan_digest(program),
                        'original_command_key':asdict(entry.key),'original_operation_id':entry.operation_id,
                        'request_digest':asdict(entry.request_digest),'state':entry.state,
                        'result':entry.result_bytes.decode('utf-8'),'stop_outcome':stopped,'recorded_at':now})
                    uow.workflow.insert_step_log(run_id=value['run_id'],ordinal=ordinal,step_id=node.id,
                        operation=node.operation,attempt=1,status=entry.state,receipt_ref=receipt)
                    uow.workflow.update_run(run_id=value['run_id'],status=status,cursor=destinations[0],
                        wait_reason=target.id if type(target) is WaitNode else None,now=now)
                    return {'run_id':value['run_id'],'status':status,'cursor':destinations[0],
                        'step_receipt_ref':asdict(receipt),'dispatched':False}
                return self._run(op,context,reads,digest,mutate)

    def start(self,parameters,context,*,read_set=None):
        op='engineering.work.start'
        value,reads,digest=self._input(op,parameters,context,read_set)
        try:
            validate_id(value['run_id'])
        except (ReferenceError,TypeError,ValueError):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT') from None
        replay=self._replay(op,context,digest)
        if replay is not None:
            return replay
        binding=self.bindings
        if binding is None or binding.source is None or binding.registry_loader is None:
            raise ApplicationError('WORK_WAIT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with binding.methods.guard_selected(context) as snapshot:
            program=binding._program(snapshot)
            nodes=[(i,n) for i,n in enumerate(program.workflow.steps) if n.id==program.workflow.entry]
            if len(nodes)!=1 or type(nodes[0][1]) is not WaitNode or nodes[0][1].event != WAIT_EVENT:
                raise ApplicationError('WORK_ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE')
            cursor,node=nodes[0]
            from ....domain.artifacts.method_binding import MethodRef
            from ....domain.common.models.values import Digest
            ref=snapshot.ref
            method=MethodRef(ref.method_id,ref.release_version,ref.schema_version,Digest('sha256',ref.snapshot_digest))
            with binding.source.guard_start(context,snapshot) as seed:
                if type(seed) is not WorkSeed or not set(seed.slots) <= set(program.workflow.context_slots or ()):
                    raise ApplicationError('WORK_INPUT_INVALID')
                marker={'work_contract':WORK_CONTRACT,'scope':asdict(context.scope),
                    'method_ref':asdict(method),'compiled_plan_digest':program_plan_digest(program)}
                inputs={**marker,'slots':_copy(seed.slots)}
                registry=registry_ref(binding.registry_loader())
                def mutate(uow):
                    material=uow.workflow.write_material(kind='method',stable_id='compiled-work:'+value['run_id'],
                        revision=1,body=marker,generated=False)
                    now=utc_now()
                    uow.workflow.insert_run(run_id=value['run_id'],method_ref=material,registry_ref=registry,inputs=inputs,now=now)
                    uow.workflow.update_run(run_id=value['run_id'],status='WAITING_FOR_CONDITION',cursor=cursor,wait_reason=node.id,now=now)
                    return {'run_id':value['run_id'],'status':'WAITING_FOR_CONDITION','cursor':cursor,
                        'method_ref':asdict(method),'dispatched':False}
                return self._run(op,context,reads,digest,mutate)

def review_observations(plan, standard, answers):
    if type(plan) is not ReviewPlan:
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    return _review_observations(plan, standard, answers, plan.check_keys)


def review_observations_subset(plan, standard, answers, check_keys):
    if (type(plan) is not ReviewPlan or type(check_keys) is not tuple or not check_keys or len(set(check_keys)) != len(check_keys)
            or not set(check_keys) <= set(plan.check_keys)):
        raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
    return _review_observations(plan, standard, answers, check_keys)


def _review_observations(plan, standard, answers, check_keys):
    """Project complete admitted answers using Engineering's frozen policies.

    Public pure conversion for actual source adapters: no authentication, model
    call or trust elevation. The caller must supply the exact frozen standard;
    admission independently calls this same function before recording evidence.
    """
    if (type(plan) is not ReviewPlan or type(answers) is not tuple
            or getattr(standard, 'standard_id', None) != plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id
            or getattr(getattr(standard, 'resource_ref', None), 'sha256', None)
                != plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex):
        raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
    criteria = {c.criterion_id: c for c in standard.criteria}
    observations, seen = [], set()
    for answer in answers:
        if (type(answer) is not CriterionAnswer or answer.check_key not in check_keys
                or answer.check_key in seen or answer.status not in ('satisfied','violated','insufficient','unknown')):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
        seen.add(answer.check_key)
        criterion = criteria.get(answer.check_key.criterion_id)
        if criterion is None:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
        if len(criterion.checks) != 1 or criterion.decision_policy is not None:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_CHECK_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE')
        disposition = getattr(criterion.policy, answer.status)
        nominal = nominal_binding(criterion)
        if nominal is not None:
            # Independently enforce the quality gate even if the external
            # disposition or source DTO asks for a pass or fail. There is no
            # exact model/evaluation owner yet; all nominal quality is manual.
            disposition = 'manual'
        result = {'pass':'pass','block':'fail','manual':'indeterminate','insufficient':'indeterminate'}[disposition]
        observations.append(Observation(answer.check_key, result, answer.evidence_refs, answer.rationale))
    if seen != set(check_keys):
        raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE')
    return tuple(sorted(observations, key=lambda o:o.check_key.sort_key))


class EngineeringReviewAdmission:
    def __init__(self, factory, method_control, bindings, reviewer_source=None):
        if getattr(method_control,'factory',None) is not factory:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory,self.methods,self.bindings,self.source=factory,method_control,bindings,reviewer_source
        self.bridge=MethodBridge()

    def _expected(self, context, plan, snapshot):
        if self.bindings is None:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_TARGET_BINDINGS_UNAVAILABLE')
        binding=self.bindings.resolve_bindings(context,plan.requirement.method_ref,plan.requirement.phase_key)
        if binding.scope != context.scope or binding.phase_key != plan.requirement.phase_key:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, binding)
        proposals={t.ref for t in binding.targets.targets if type(t.ref) is ProposalRef}
        selector = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_review_proposal', None)
        if callable(selector):
            selected = selector(context, plan.requirement.method_ref, plan.requirement.phase_key)
            if selected is not None:
                if (type(selected) is not ProposalRef
                        or (selected.realm_id, selected.project_id) != (context.scope.realm_id, context.scope.project_id)
                        or proposals and proposals != {selected}):
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                proposals = {selected}
            elif proposals:
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        submission_selector = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_review_submission', None)
        submission_ref = (submission_selector(context, plan.requirement.method_ref, plan.requirement.phase_key)
                          if callable(submission_selector) else None)
        if submission_ref is not None:
            if (type(submission_ref) is not SubmissionRef
                    or (submission_ref.realm_id, submission_ref.project_id) !=
                       (context.scope.realm_id, context.scope.project_id)):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_submission_bindings', None)
            if not callable(resolver):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            phase_bindings = resolver(context, plan.requirement.method_ref, submission_ref)
            if (type(phase_bindings) is not tuple or not phase_bindings or binding not in phase_bindings
                    or len({b.phase_key for b in phase_bindings}) != len(phase_bindings)):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            for phase in phase_bindings:
                if phase.scope != context.scope or phase.review_purpose != 'acceptance':
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REVIEW_PURPOSE_UNAVAILABLE')
                self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, phase)
            from ..changes.acceptance_closure import resolve_submission_acceptance
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope, 'read') as uow:
                closure = resolve_submission_acceptance(uow, submission_ref)
            if (closure.submission.ref != submission_ref
                    or closure.package.payload.method_ref != plan.requirement.method_ref):
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            self.bridge.submission_review_requirements(snapshot, phase_bindings,
                requirements=closure.requirements, revisions=closure.artifact_revisions)
            expected = self.bridge.review_plan(snapshot, binding, plan.requirement,
                plan.review_id, revisions=closure.artifact_revisions,
                phase_bindings=phase_bindings, submission_requirements=closure.requirements)
            if expected != plan:
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REVIEW_PLAN_CHANGED')
            standards = [s for s in snapshot.program.standard_definitions
                if s.resource_ref.sha256 == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex
                and s.standard_id == plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id]
            if len(standards) != 1:
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
            return standards[0]
        if any(type(t.ref) is SubmissionRef for t in binding.targets.targets):
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        arguments={}
        materials=[]
        # Resolve every exact material target from the original authority.
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            for target in binding.targets.targets:
                if type(target.ref) is ArtifactRevisionRef:
                    materials.append(uow.engineering.resolve_revision(target.ref))
                elif type(target.ref) is not ProposalRef:
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_OWNER_UNAVAILABLE')
        arguments['revisions']=tuple({m.ref:m for m in materials}.values())
        if proposals:
            if len(proposals)!=1:
                raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
                proposal=uow.proposals.get_proposal(next(iter(proposals)))
                budget=uow.proposals.validated_budget()
                resolve_record(proposal,uow.proposals,budget)
                roots=tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in proposal.mutations)+tuple(m.base_ref for m in proposal.mutations if m.base_ref is not None)+tuple(c.owner_revision_ref for c in proposal.claim_refs)
                revisions=uow.proposals.resolve_revision_graph(roots,budget)
                owners=tuple(uow.engineering.get_artifact(m.artifact_id) for m in proposal.mutations)
                owners=tuple(replace(o,head_revision_id=None) if m.operation=='create' else o for o,m in zip(owners,proposal.mutations))
            arguments=dict(proposal=proposal,artifacts=owners,revisions=revisions)
            resolver = getattr(self.bindings, 'resolve_intent_bindings', None)
            if callable(resolver):
                phases = resolver(context, plan.requirement.method_ref, proposal.ref)
                if type(phases) is not tuple or binding not in phases:
                    raise ApplicationError('METHOD_SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
                for phase in phases:
                    self.bridge.require_workflow_phase(snapshot, phase)
                arguments['phase_bindings'] = phases
        expected=self.bridge.review_plan(snapshot,binding,plan.requirement,plan.review_id,**arguments)
        if expected != plan:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REVIEW_PLAN_CHANGED')
        standards=[s for s in snapshot.program.standard_definitions if s.resource_ref.sha256==plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex and s.standard_id==plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id]
        if len(standards)!=1:
            raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
        return standards[0]

    @contextmanager
    def guard_plan(self, context, plan):
        if type(plan) is not ReviewPlan or plan.scope != context.scope:
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context,plan.requirement.method_ref) as snapshot:
            self._expected(context,plan,snapshot)
            yield

    def verify_response(self, context, plan, request, raw_response_ref):
        if self.source is None:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context,plan.requirement.method_ref) as snapshot:
            standard=self._expected(context,plan,snapshot)
        if (request.scope!=context.scope or request.review_id!=plan.review_id or request.state!='requested'):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_REQUEST_CHANGED')
        # The trusted source owner verifies actual provenance; Engineering owns
        # the disposition conversion. No source can directly submit a verdict.
        verified=self.source.verify_response(context,plan,request,raw_response_ref,standard=standard)
        if type(verified) is not VerifiedReviewResponse or type(verified.reviewer_evidence) is not VerifiedReviewerEvidence or type(verified.answers) is not tuple:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
        evidence=verified.reviewer_evidence
        if (evidence.scope!=context.scope or evidence.request_digest!=plan.request_digest or evidence.raw_response_digest!=raw_response_ref.digest or not set(evidence.roles)&set(plan.reviewer_requirements)):
            raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
        observations=review_observations(plan,standard,verified.answers)
        if evidence.observations_digest != observations_digest(observations):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
        return ReviewRecord(RecordIdentity(context.scope,plan.review_id,context.received_at,context.authenticated_actor,schema_version=2),plan,evidence,observations,raw_response_ref=raw_response_ref)

    @contextmanager
    def guard_trust(self, context, records):
        if self.source is None:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_TRUST_UNAVAILABLE')
        if type(records) is not tuple or any(type(r) is not ReviewRecord or r.plan.scope!=context.scope for r in records):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT')
        with self.source.guard_trust(context,records) as current:
            yield _trust(records,current)

class EngineeringHumanReviewAdmission:
    def __init__(self,factory,method_control,bindings,manual_authority=None,*,blobs,mechanical_source=None):
        if getattr(blobs,'authority_id',None)!=factory.authority_id:
            raise ApplicationError('BLOB_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        if mechanical_source is not None and (getattr(mechanical_source,'factory',None) is not factory
                or getattr(mechanical_source,'methods',None) is not method_control):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.base=EngineeringReviewAdmission(factory,method_control,bindings)
        self.factory,self.methods,self.blobs=factory,method_control,blobs
        self.authority,self.mechanical=manual_authority,mechanical_source

    def guard_plan(self,context,plan):return self.base.guard_plan(context,plan)

    def _decode(self,plan,raw_ref):
        raw=self.blobs.read_verified(raw_ref)
        if len(raw)>2097152:raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        value=decode_json(raw)
        require_object(value,{'contract','plan_digest','request_version','fence','answer_mode',
            'displayed_check_keys','reply','mechanical_proof_ref'},'HUMAN_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        if (canonical_bytes(value)!=raw or value['contract']!=_CONTRACT
                or decode_digest(value['plan_digest'])!=plan.plan_digest
                or type(value['request_version']) is not int or not 0<=value['request_version']<=9007199254740991
                or type(value['fence']) is not int or not 1<=value['fence']<=9007199254740991
                or value['answer_mode'] not in ('per_check','whole_plan')
                or type(value['displayed_check_keys']) is not list
                or tuple(_key(k) for k in value['displayed_check_keys'])!=plan.check_keys):
            raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        row=value['reply']
        require_object(row,{'question','necessary_context','user_answer','source','check_answers'},'HUMAN_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        if type(row['check_answers']) is not list:raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        if type(row['user_answer']) is not str or not row['user_answer'].strip():
            raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_ANSWER_PENDING')
        for text in (row['question'],row['necessary_context'],row['user_answer']):validate_text(text)
        # These explicit implementation-only/ambiguous phrases were ruled out
        # by the user. Other wording still requires actual source verification;
        # absence from this list is never evidence of an explicit review answer.
        words=row['user_answer'].strip().rstrip('。.!！?？')
        if words in ('继续','可以干','继续实施','继续执行','可以','好的','开始吧'):
            raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_ANSWER_PENDING')
        reply=ManualReviewReply(row['question'],row['necessary_context'],row['user_answer'],
            decode_record(canonical_bytes(row['source']),ConversationSource),tuple(_answer(a) for a in row['check_answers']))
        return FrozenCheckRequest(plan.plan_digest,value['request_version'],value['fence']),reply,decode_blob_ref(value['mechanical_proof_ref'])

    @contextmanager
    def _guard(self,context,plan,raw_ref,*,expected=None):
        if self.authority is None or not callable(getattr(self.authority,'guard_disposition',None)):
            raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        if self.mechanical is None:raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with self.methods.guard_method(context,plan.requirement.method_ref) as snapshot:
            standard=self.base._expected(context,plan,snapshot)
            frozen,reply,proof_ref=self._decode(plan,raw_ref)
            criteria={c.criterion_id:c for c in standard.criteria}
            keys=tuple(k for k in plan.check_keys if len(criteria[k.criterion_id].checks)==1 and
                criteria[k.criterion_id].checks[0].capability_id in ('ordessa.sources.integrity','ordessa.claims.coverage'))
            if not keys:raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_NOT_ADMITTED')
            checked=self.mechanical.verify_checks(context,plan,frozen,proof_ref,standard=standard,check_keys=keys)
            admission=CheckSourceAdmission(plan,frozen,proof_ref,keys,checked)
            with self.mechanical.guard_checks(context,(admission,)), self.authority.guard_disposition(
                    context,plan,frozen,raw_ref,reply,standard=standard,
                    mechanical_answers=checked.answers,expected=expected) as verified:
                if type(verified) is not VerifiedHumanDisposition or verified.explicit_answer is not True:
                    raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_ANSWER_PENDING')
                observations=human_review_observations(plan,standard,reply,verified.policy_bytes,checked.answers)
                if verified.presentation_digest!=human_review_presentation_digest(plan,reply,verified.policy_bytes):
                    raise ApplicationError('HUMAN_REVIEW_PRESENTATION_CHANGED')
                evidence=verified.reviewer_evidence
                if (type(evidence) is not VerifiedReviewerEvidence or evidence.scope!=context.scope
                        or evidence.reviewer.actor_kind!='human' or evidence.request_digest!=plan.request_digest
                        or evidence.raw_response_digest!=raw_ref.digest
                        or evidence.observations_digest!=observations_digest(observations)
                        or not set(evidence.roles)&set(plan.reviewer_requirements)
                        or expected is not None and evidence!=expected):
                    raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
                yield frozen,evidence,observations

    def verify_response(self,context,plan,request,raw_response_ref):
        with self._guard(context,plan,raw_response_ref) as (frozen,evidence,observations):
            if (request.scope!=context.scope or request.review_id!=plan.review_id or request.state!='requested'
                    or request.version!=frozen.request_version or request.fence!=frozen.fence):
                raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_REQUEST_CHANGED')
            return ReviewRecord(RecordIdentity(context.scope,plan.review_id,context.received_at,
                context.authenticated_actor,schema_version=2),plan,evidence,observations,raw_response_ref=raw_response_ref)

    @contextmanager
    def guard_trust(self,context,records):
        if type(records) is not tuple or any(type(r) is not ReviewRecord or r.plan.scope!=context.scope for r in records):
            raise ApplicationError('INVALID_INPUT')
        with ExitStack() as guards:
            current=[]
            for record in records:
                _,evidence,observations=guards.enter_context(self._guard(context,record.plan,record.raw_response_ref,
                    expected=record.reviewer_evidence))
                if observations!=record.observations:raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
                current.append(CurrentReviewTrust(record.ref,evidence.verifier_id,evidence.trust_version))
            yield tuple(current)

class ManualReviewCapture:
    def __init__(self,factory,access=None,*,review_admission=None,manual_authority=None,blobs=None):
        if blobs is not None and getattr(blobs,'authority_id',None)!=factory.authority_id:
            raise ApplicationError('BLOB_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory,self.access,self.admission,self.authority,self.blobs=factory,access,review_admission,manual_authority,blobs

    def capture(self,review_id,reply,context,*,expected_request_version,fence):
        if self.access is None:raise ApplicationError('ACCESS_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        self.access.require(context,'engineering.reviews.capture_manual_reply')
        if self.authority is None or self.admission is None or self.blobs is None:
            raise ApplicationError('MANUAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        if type(reply) is not ManualReviewReply or type(reply.source) is not ConversationSource:
            raise ApplicationError('MANUAL_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
        for value in (reply.question,reply.necessary_context,reply.user_answer):validate_text(value)
        with self.factory.begin(context.scope,'read') as uow:
            plan=uow.reviews.get_plan(review_id);request=uow.reviews.get_request(review_id)
        if (request.scope!=context.scope or request.state!='requested'
                or type(expected_request_version) is not int or type(fence) is not int
                or request.version!=expected_request_version or request.fence!=fence):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_REQUEST_CHANGED')
        if (type(reply.check_answers) is not tuple or not reply.check_answers
                or any(type(a) is not CriterionAnswer or a.status not in {'satisfied','violated','insufficient','unknown'} for a in reply.check_answers)
                or len({a.check_key for a in reply.check_answers})!=len(reply.check_answers)
                or {a.check_key for a in reply.check_answers}!=set(plan.check_keys)):
            raise ApplicationError('MANUAL_REVIEW_REPLY_INCOMPLETE')
        with self.admission.guard_plan(context,plan), self.authority.guard_reply(context,plan,request,reply) as verified:
            if (type(verified) is not VerifiedReviewerEvidence or verified.scope!=context.scope
                    or verified.reviewer.actor_kind!='human' or verified.request_digest!=plan.request_digest
                    or not set(verified.roles)&set(plan.reviewer_requirements)):
                raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
            # Bind exactly what the trusted human-source port verified. DTO
            # structured answers/approved booleans alone never enter this path.
            reply_bytes=canonical_bytes(asdict(reply))
            reply_digest=Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(reply_bytes).hexdigest())
            if verified.raw_response_digest!=reply_digest:raise ApplicationError('MANUAL_REVIEW_REPLY_CHANGED')
            raw=canonical_bytes({'contract':'ordessa.manual-review-reply/1','plan_digest':asdict(plan.plan_digest),
                'request_version':request.version,'fence':request.fence,'reply':asdict(reply),
                'verified_source':asdict(verified),'quality_disposition':'manual','grant_created':False})
            if len(raw)>2097152:raise ApplicationError('MANUAL_REVIEW_REPLY_INVALID')
            ref=self.blobs.put_verified(raw,Digest('sha256',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()),'application/json')
            value={'kind':'other','initial':{'media_type':'application/json','schema_id':'urn:ordessa:manual-review-reply:1','blob_ref':asdict(ref)}}
            reads=ReadSet(context.scope,(),review_requests=(ReviewRequestExpectation(context.scope,review_id,
                plan.plan_digest,request.version,request.fence),))
            # Original Artifact journal/readset/CAS/Blob validation owns COMMIT;
            # upstream source and method guards remain held throughout it.
            return ArtifactUseCases(self.factory,self.access).create(value,context,read_set=reads)

class MixedReviewerSource:
    def __init__(self,factory,method_control,blobs,*,sources,source_for_capability,reviewer_authority=None):
        if getattr(method_control,'factory',None) is not factory or getattr(blobs,'authority_id',None)!=factory.authority_id:
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH')
        self.factory,self.methods,self.blobs=factory,method_control,blobs
        self.sources=dict(sources);self.mapping=dict(source_for_capability);self.authority=reviewer_authority

    def _parts(self,plan,raw_ref,standard):
        raw=self.blobs.read_verified(raw_ref)
        if len(raw)>2097152:raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_RAW_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        value=decode_json(raw)
        require_object(value,{'contract','plan_digest','request_version','fence','parts'},'REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
        if (canonical_bytes(value)!=raw or value['contract']!=_CONTRACT or decode_digest(value['plan_digest'])!=plan.plan_digest
                or type(value['request_version']) is not int or not 0<=value['request_version']<=9007199254740991
                or type(value['fence']) is not int or not 1<=value['fence']<=9007199254740991
                or type(value['parts']) is not list or not 1<=len(value['parts'])<=4096):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
        criteria={c.criterion_id:c for c in standard.criteria}
        parts=[];seen=set();sources=set()
        for row in value['parts']:
            require_object(row,{'source_id','check_keys','raw_response_ref'},'REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
            source=row['source_id'];keys=row['check_keys']
            if type(source) is not str or source not in self.sources or source in sources or type(keys) is not list or not keys:
                raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
            sources.add(source);keys=tuple(_key(k) for k in keys)
            if len(set(keys))!=len(keys) or seen.intersection(keys) or not set(keys)<=set(plan.check_keys):
                raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
            for key in keys:
                criterion=criteria.get(key.criterion_id)
                if criterion is None or len(criterion.checks)!=1:raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
                check=criterion.checks[0]
                if self.mapping.get((check.capability_id,check.interface_version))!=source:
                    raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            seen.update(keys);parts.append(MixedCheckPart(source,keys,decode_blob_ref(row['raw_response_ref'])))
        if seen!=set(plan.check_keys):raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE')
        return FrozenCheckRequest(plan.plan_digest,value['request_version'],value['fence']),tuple(parts)

    def _verify(self,context,plan,frozen,parts,standard):
        admissions=[];answers=[]
        for part in parts:
            source=self.sources[part.source_id]
            verified=source.verify_checks(context,plan,frozen,part.raw_response_ref,standard=standard,check_keys=part.check_keys)
            if type(verified) is not VerifiedCheckResponse or type(verified.provenance_digest) is not Digest:
                raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
            review_observations_subset(plan,standard,verified.answers,part.check_keys)
            admissions.append((part.source_id,CheckSourceAdmission(plan,frozen,part.raw_response_ref,part.check_keys,verified)))
            answers.extend(verified.answers)
        answers=tuple(sorted(answers,key=lambda a:a.check_key.sort_key))
        observations=review_observations(plan,standard,answers)
        provenance=record_digest('mixed-review-provenance',{'plan_digest':asdict(plan.plan_digest),
            'request':asdict(frozen),'sources':[{'source_id':sid,'raw_response_ref':asdict(a.raw_response_ref),
              'keys':[asdict(k) for k in a.check_keys],'answers':[asdict(x) for x in a.response.answers],
              'provenance_digest':asdict(a.response.provenance_digest)} for sid,a in admissions]})
        return admissions,answers,observations,provenance

    @staticmethod
    def _evidence(context,plan,raw,obs,evidence):
        if (type(evidence) is not VerifiedReviewerEvidence or evidence.scope!=context.scope
                or evidence.request_digest!=plan.request_digest or evidence.raw_response_digest!=raw.digest
                or evidence.observations_digest!=obs or not set(evidence.roles)&set(plan.reviewer_requirements)):
            raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
        return evidence

    def verify_response(self,context,plan,request,raw_response_ref,*,standard):
        if self.authority is None:raise ApplicationError('MIXED_REVIEWER_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        frozen,parts=self._parts(plan,raw_response_ref,standard)
        if (request.scope!=context.scope or request.review_id!=plan.review_id or request.state!='requested'
                or request.version!=frozen.request_version or request.fence!=frozen.fence):
            raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_REQUEST_CHANGED')
        admissions,answers,observations,provenance=self._verify(context,plan,frozen,parts,standard)
        obs=observations_digest(observations)
        with ExitStack() as guards:
            for sid,admission in admissions:
                guards.enter_context(self.sources[sid].guard_checks(context,(admission,)))
            evidence=guards.enter_context(self.authority.guard_verification(context,plan,raw_response_ref,obs,provenance))
            return VerifiedReviewResponse(self._evidence(context,plan,raw_response_ref,obs,evidence),answers)

    @contextmanager
    def guard_trust(self,context,records):
        if self.authority is None:raise ApplicationError('MIXED_REVIEWER_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE')
        with ExitStack() as guards:
            current=[]
            for record in records:
                plan=record.plan
                snapshot=guards.enter_context(self.methods.guard_method(context,plan.requirement.method_ref))
                standards=[s for s in snapshot.program.standard_definitions
                    if s.standard_id==plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.criterion_set_id
                    and s.resource_ref.sha256==plan.requirement.criterion_set_ref.digest.hex]
                if len(standards)!=1:raise ApplicationError('METHOD_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED')
                frozen,parts=self._parts(plan,record.raw_response_ref,standards[0])
                admissions,answers,observations,provenance=self._verify(context,plan,frozen,parts,standards[0])
                if observations!=record.observations:raise ApplicationError('REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID')
                for sid,admission in admissions:
                    guards.enter_context(self.sources[sid].guard_checks(context,(admission,)))
                obs=observations_digest(observations)
                evidence=guards.enter_context(self.authority.guard_verification(context,plan,record.raw_response_ref,obs,provenance,expected=record.reviewer_evidence))
                self._evidence(context,plan,record.raw_response_ref,obs,evidence)
                if evidence!=record.reviewer_evidence:raise ApplicationError('UNTRUSTED_REVIEWER')
                current.append(CurrentReviewTrust(record.ref,evidence.verifier_id,evidence.trust_version))
            yield tuple(current)

def _refs(scope, refs):
    validate_items(refs, ArtifactRevisionRef, nonempty=True)
    if len(set(refs)) != len(refs) or any((r.realm_id, r.project_id) !=
            (scope.realm_id, scope.project_id) for r in refs):
        raise ReferenceError('INVALID_ACCEPTANCE_TARGETS')


def _seal(record, kind):
    payload = {k: v for k, v in asdict(record).items() if k != 'digest'}
    if len(canonical_bytes(payload)) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ReferenceError('CONSENT_RECORD_TOO_LARGE')
    object.__setattr__(record, 'digest', record_digest(kind, payload))

    actions: tuple[str, ...] = ('accept_artifact',)

            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_INTENT')
        _refs(self.scope, self.targets)
        if type(self.notice_ref) is not NoticeRef or self.notice_ref.scope != self.scope:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_NOTICE')
        if self.actions != ('accept_artifact',) or self.acceptance_use not in {'reference', 'adopt_content'}:
            raise ReferenceError('UNSUPPORTED_AUTHORIZATION_ACTION')
        if type(self.action_budget) is not int or not 1 <= self.action_budget <= 4096:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_BUDGET')
        validate_items(self.required_review_requirements, ReviewRequirement, nonempty=True)
        keys = [(r.requirement_id, r.requirement_version) for r in self.required_review_requirements]
        if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
        covered = set()
        for requirement in self.required_review_requirements:
            if requirement.scope != self.scope or requirement.method_ref != self.method_ref:
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
            refs = {target.ref for target in requirement.expected_targets.targets}
            if not refs.issubset(set(self.targets)):
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
            covered.update(refs)

        validate_text(self.request_summary)
        utc_instant(self.not_before)
        utc_instant(self.expires_at)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ImplementationAuthorizationIntent:
    """Exact request for bounded implementation actions, not a grant."""

    scope: Scope
    intent_id: str
    change_set: ChangeSet
    targets: tuple[ArtifactRevisionRef, ...]
    method_ref: MethodRef
    notice_ref: NoticeRef
    policy_ref: ConsentPolicyRef
    implementation_spec: ImplementationIntentSpec
    required_review_requirements: tuple[ReviewRequirement, ...]
    supporting_review_refs: tuple[ReviewRef, ...]
    scope_by_action: tuple[tuple[str, ActionScope], ...]
    action_budgets: tuple[ActionBudgetSlot, ...]
    request_summary: str
    not_before: str
    expires_at: str
    actions: tuple[str, ...]
    intent_kind: str = field(default='implementation', init=False)
    digest: Digest = field(init=False, default=None)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.scope) is not Scope or type(self.change_set) is not ChangeSet:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_INTENT')
        validate_id(self.intent_id)
        if (type(self.method_ref) is not MethodRef or type(self.notice_ref) is not NoticeRef
                or type(self.policy_ref) is not ConsentPolicyRef
                or type(self.implementation_spec) is not ImplementationIntentSpec):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_INTENT')
        if self.notice_ref.scope != self.scope:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_NOTICE')

        validate_items(self.actions, str, nonempty=True)
        if (any(action not in ACTIONS or action in _FORBIDDEN_IMPLEMENTATION_ACTIONS
                for action in self.actions)
                or len(set(self.actions)) != len(self.actions)
                or not set(self.actions).issubset(self.implementation_spec.requested_actions)):
            raise ReferenceError('UNSUPPORTED_AUTHORIZATION_ACTION')

        spec = self.implementation_spec
        if spec.digest != record_digest('implementation-intent-spec', spec.hash_payload()):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION_INTENT')
        if (spec.scope.project_id != self.scope.project_id
                or any(ref.realm_id != self.scope.realm_id for ref in spec.expected_baselines)
                or any((ref.realm_id, ref.project_id) !=
                       (self.scope.realm_id, self.scope.project_id)
                       for ref in self.change_set.proposal_refs)):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')

        validate_items(self.targets, ArtifactRevisionRef, nonempty=True)
        if (len(set(self.targets)) != len(self.targets)
                or any((ref.realm_id, ref.project_id) !=
                       (self.scope.realm_id, self.scope.project_id) for ref in self.targets)):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_TARGETS')

        validate_items(self.required_review_requirements, ReviewRequirement, nonempty=True)
        requirement_keys = [(r.requirement_id, r.requirement_version)
                            for r in self.required_review_requirements]
        if len(set(requirement_keys)) != len(requirement_keys):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
        design_targets = set(self.targets)
        covered_design_targets = set()
        for requirement in self.required_review_requirements:
            if requirement.scope != self.scope or requirement.method_ref != self.method_ref:
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
            refs = {target.ref for target in requirement.expected_targets.targets}
            if any((ref.realm_id, ref.project_id) !=
                   (self.scope.realm_id, self.scope.project_id) for ref in refs):
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')
            covered_design_targets.update(refs & design_targets)
        if covered_design_targets != design_targets:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')

        validate_items(self.supporting_review_refs, ReviewRef)
        if (len(set(self.supporting_review_refs)) != len(self.supporting_review_refs)
                or any((ref.realm_id, ref.project_id) !=
                       (self.scope.realm_id, self.scope.project_id)
                       for ref in self.supporting_review_refs)):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIREMENTS')

        validate_items(self.scope_by_action, tuple, nonempty=True)
        scope_map = {}
        for entry in self.scope_by_action:
            if (type(entry) is not tuple or len(entry) != 2 or type(entry[0]) is not str
                    or type(entry[1]) is not ActionScope or entry[0] in scope_map):
                raise ReferenceError('INVALID_ACTION_SCOPE')
            scope_map[entry[0]] = entry[1]
        if set(scope_map) != set(self.actions) or any(value != spec.scope for value in scope_map.values()):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_ACTION_SCOPE')

        validate_items(self.action_budgets, ActionBudgetSlot, nonempty=True)
        budget_map = {slot.action: slot.limit for slot in self.action_budgets}
        if len(budget_map) != len(self.action_budgets) or set(budget_map) != set(self.actions):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_BUDGET')

        validate_text(self.request_summary)
        utc_instant(self.not_before)
        utc_instant(self.expires_at)
        if self.not_before >= self.expires_at:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_CONSENT_TIME')

        payload = {key: value for key, value in asdict(self).items()
                   if key != 'digest'}
        if len(canonical_bytes(payload)) > MAX_IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION_BYTES:
            raise ReferenceError('CONSENT_RECORD_TOO_LARGE')
        object.__setattr__(self, 'digest', record_digest('implementation-authorization-intent', payload))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HeadExpectation:
    artifact_id: str
    version: int
    head_ref: ArtifactRevisionRef | None

    def __post_init__(self):
        validate_id(self.artifact_id)
        if type(self.version) is not int or not 0 <= self.version <= (1 << 63) - 1:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_VERSION')
        if self.head_ref is not None and (type(self.head_ref) is not ArtifactRevisionRef
                or self.head_ref.artifact_id != self.artifact_id):
            raise ReferenceError('BASE_TARGET_MISMATCH')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HeadMutation:
    expected: HeadExpectation
    proposed_ref: ArtifactRevisionRef

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.expected) is not HeadExpectation or type(self.proposed_ref) is not ArtifactRevisionRef:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_MUTATION')
        if self.expected.artifact_id != self.proposed_ref.artifact_id:
            raise ReferenceError('BASE_TARGET_MISMATCH')
        if self.expected.version >= (1 << 63) - 1:
            raise ReferenceError('VERSION_EXHAUSTED')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeMutationPlan:
    change_set: ChangeSet
    mutations: tuple[HeadMutation, ...]

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.change_set) is not ChangeSet or type(self.mutations) is not tuple or not self.mutations:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_CHANGE_SET')
        if any(type(m) is not HeadMutation for m in self.mutations):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_MUTATION')
        if len({m.expected.artifact_id for m in self.mutations}) != len(self.mutations):
            raise ReferenceError('DUPLICATE_MUTATION')


def plan_change_application(proposals, controls, artifacts, revisions, expectations):
    """Validate exact resolved values; the application supplies authority/gates."""
    result = validate_change_set(proposals, controls)
    if not result.ok:
        raise ReferenceError(result.error.code.value)
    if (type(artifacts) is not tuple or type(revisions) is not tuple or type(expectations) is not tuple
            or any(type(a) is not Artifact for a in artifacts)
            or any(type(r) is not ArtifactRevision for r in revisions)
            or any(type(e) is not HeadExpectation for e in expectations)):
        raise ReferenceError('INVALID_RESOLVED_GRAPH')
    owners = {a.artifact_id: a for a in artifacts}
    expected = {e.artifact_id: e for e in expectations}
    graph = {r.ref: r for r in revisions}
    mutation_ids = {m.artifact_id for p in proposals for m in p.mutations}
    if (len(owners) != len(artifacts) or len(expected) != len(expectations)
            or len(graph) != len(revisions) or set(owners) != mutation_ids or set(expected) != mutation_ids):
        raise ReferenceError('INCOMPLETE_BATCH')
    planned = []
    for proposal in proposals:
        # Each proposal owns only its mutation owners, but sees the supplied
        # closed graph for claims and parents. No latest lookup happens here.
        validate_proposal(proposal, tuple(owners[m.artifact_id] for m in proposal.mutations), revisions)
        for mutation in proposal.mutations:
            owner, expectation = owners[mutation.artifact_id], expected[mutation.artifact_id]
            if owner.version != expectation.version:
                raise ReferenceError('VERSION_CONFLICT')
            current_ref = None
            if owner.head_revision_id is not None:
                matches = [r.ref for r in revisions if r.artifact_id == owner.artifact_id
                           and r.revision_id == owner.head_revision_id]
                if len(matches) != 1:
                    raise ReferenceError('INVALID_RESOLVED_GRAPH')
                current_ref = matches[0]
            if current_ref != expectation.head_ref or current_ref != mutation.base_ref:
                raise ReferenceError('BASE_TARGET_MISMATCH')
            planned.append(HeadMutation(expectation, mutation.proposed_ref))
    return ChangeMutationPlan(result.value, tuple(sorted(planned, key=lambda m: m.expected.artifact_id)))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeApplicationReceipt:
    scope: Scope
    apply_id: str
    action_instance_id: str
    approval_ref: ApprovalRef
    intent_digest: Digest
    change_set: ChangeSet
    mutations: tuple[HeadMutation, ...]
    review_refs: tuple[ReviewRef, ...]
    grant_control_version: int
    applied_at: str
    digest: Digest = field(init=False, default=None)

    def __post_init__(self):
        validate_id(self.apply_id)
        validate_id(self.action_instance_id)
        utc_instant(self.applied_at)
        validate_version(self.grant_control_version)
        if type(self.scope) is not Scope or type(self.approval_ref) is not ApprovalRef or type(self.intent_digest) is not Digest:
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_CHANGE_SET')
        ChangeMutationPlan(self.change_set, self.mutations)
        refs = tuple(self.change_set.proposal_refs) + tuple(m.proposed_ref for m in self.mutations)
        refs += tuple(m.expected.head_ref for m in self.mutations if m.expected.head_ref is not None)
        if type(self.review_refs) is not tuple or any(type(r) is not ReviewRef for r in self.review_refs):
            raise ReferenceError('INVALID_REVIEW')
        refs += self.review_refs + (self.approval_ref,)
        if any((r.realm_id, r.project_id) != (self.scope.realm_id, self.scope.project_id) for r in refs):
            raise ReferenceError('REALM_MISMATCH')
        body = {k: v for k, v in asdict(self).items() if k != 'digest'}
        if len(canonical_bytes(body)) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ReferenceError('PROPOSAL_TOO_LARGE')
        object.__setattr__(self, 'digest', record_digest('change-application-receipt', body))


def decode_application_receipt(raw):
    from ..common.mechanisms.codec import canonical_value, require_object, decode_scope, decode_digest, decode_tuple
    from ..artifacts.ref_codec import decode_artifact_ref
    from ..approvals.ref_codec import decode_approval_ref
    from ..reviews.ref_codec import decode_review_ref
    from .ref_codec import decode_proposal_ref
    value = canonical_value(raw)
    require_object(value, {f.name for f in fields(ChangeApplicationReceipt)}, 'INVALID_CHANGE_SET')
    change = value['change_set']
    require_object(change, {'proposal_refs', 'digest'}, 'INVALID_CHANGE_SET')
    batch = ChangeSet(decode_tuple(change['proposal_refs'], decode_proposal_ref, 'INVALID_CHANGE_SET'))
    if batch.digest != decode_digest(change['digest']):
        raise ReferenceError('DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    def mutation(v):
        require_object(v, {'expected', 'proposed_ref'}, 'INVALID_MUTATION')
        h = v['expected']
        require_object(h, {'artifact_id', 'version', 'head_ref'}, 'INVALID_MUTATION')
        return HeadMutation(HeadExpectation(h['artifact_id'], h['version'],
            None if h['head_ref'] is None else decode_artifact_ref(h['head_ref'])), decode_artifact_ref(v['proposed_ref']))
    receipt = ChangeApplicationReceipt(decode_scope(value['scope']), value['apply_id'], value['action_instance_id'],
        decode_approval_ref(value['approval_ref']), decode_digest(value['intent_digest']), batch,
        decode_tuple(value['mutations'], mutation, 'INVALID_MUTATION'),
        decode_tuple(value['review_refs'], decode_review_ref, 'INVALID_REVIEW'),
        value['grant_control_version'], value['applied_at'])
    if receipt.digest != decode_digest(value['digest']):
        raise ReferenceError('DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    return receipt

from ordessa_engineering.domain.common.outcomes.library_failures import EngineeringError

def apply_proposal_text(baseline, proposal):
    target_text = baseline.get('text')
    if type(target_text) is not str:
        raise EngineeringError('application_baseline_text_missing')
    for retained in proposal.get('retained_constraints', []):
        locator = retained.get('did_locator')
        exact_text = retained.get('exact_text')
        matching_lines = [line for line in target_text.splitlines() if type(locator) is str and line.startswith(f'{locator}:')]
        if len(matching_lines) != 1 or matching_lines[0] != exact_text:
            raise EngineeringError('application_retained_constraint_conflict')
    for change in proposal.get('changes', []):
        locator = change.get('did_locator')
        exact_before = change.get('before_text')
        matching_lines = [line for line in target_text.splitlines() if type(locator) is str and line.startswith(f'{locator}:')]
        if change.get('operation') != 'modify' or len(matching_lines) != 1 or matching_lines[0] != exact_before or (type(change.get('after_text')) is not str) or ('\n' in change['after_text']) or ('\r' in change['after_text']):
            raise EngineeringError('application_change_conflict')
        lines = target_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        match_index = next((index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip('\r\n') == exact_before))
        ending = '\r\n' if lines[match_index].endswith('\r\n') else '\n' if lines[match_index].endswith('\n') else ''
        lines[match_index] = change['after_text'] + ending
        target_text = ''.join(lines)
    return target_text

def encode_dispatch(binding):
    return canonical_bytes(binding.projection()|{'digest':asdict(binding.digest)})


def decode_dispatch(raw):
    value=canonical_value(raw);require_object(value,{f.name for f in fields(DispatchBinding)},'INVALID_DISPATCH_BINDING')
    def pair(item):
        if type(item) is not list or len(item)!=2:raise ReferenceError('INVALID_DISPATCH_BINDING')
        return tuple(item)
    kwargs=dict(value);kwargs.pop('digest')
    kwargs.update(scope=decode_scope(value['scope']),package_ref=decode_package_ref(value['package_ref']),
        approval_ref=decode_approval_ref(value['approval_ref']),intent_digest=decode_digest(value['intent_digest']),
        prompt_ref=decode_blob_ref(value['prompt_ref']),prompt_input_digest=decode_digest(value['prompt_input_digest']),
        unit_ref_bytes=canonical_bytes(value['unit_ref_bytes']),
        action_instances=decode_tuple(value['action_instances'],pair,'INVALID_DISPATCH_BINDING'),
        required_results=decode_tuple(value['required_results'],lambda x:x,'INVALID_DISPATCH_BINDING'))
    binding=DispatchBinding(**kwargs)
    if binding.digest!=decode_digest(value['digest']) or encode_dispatch(binding)!=raw:raise ReferenceError('INVALID_DISPATCH_BINDING')
    return binding

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DomainError:
    code: DomainErrorCode
    subject_refs: tuple["SubjectRef | ReviewRef | ApprovalRef", ...] = ()
    details: tuple[tuple[str, int | bool], ...] = ()
    violations: tuple["DomainError", ...] = ()
    message_key: str = field(init=False)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.code) is not DomainErrorCode:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
        if type(self.subject_refs) is not tuple or len(self.subject_refs) > 4096:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
        ref_types = {ArtifactRevisionRef, ProposalRef, SubmissionRef,
                     RepositorySnapshotRef, ReviewRef, ApprovalRef}
        if any(type(ref) not in ref_types for ref in self.subject_refs):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
        safe_keys = {"expected_version", "actual_version", "expected_count",
                     "actual_count", "limit", "index"}
        if (type(self.details) is not tuple or len(self.details) > len(safe_keys)
                or any(type(pair) is not tuple or len(pair) != 2 or
                       type(pair[0]) is not str or pair[0] not in safe_keys or
                       type(pair[1]) not in {int, bool} or
                       (type(pair[1]) is int and not 0 <= pair[1] <= (1 << 63) - 1)
                       for pair in self.details)
                or len({pair[0] for pair in self.details}) != len(self.details)):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
        if (type(self.violations) is not tuple or len(self.violations) > 4096
                or any(type(item) is not DomainError for item in self.violations)):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
        # Count occurrences, including shared child values, because wire output
        # repeats them. Per-layer bounds alone permit exponential expansion.
        pending = [(self, 0)]
        visited = 0
        while pending:
            item, depth = pending.pop()
            visited += 1
            if depth > 32 or visited > 4096:
                raise ValueError("INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR")
            pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item.violations)
        object.__setattr__(self, "details", tuple(sorted(self.details)))
        object.__setattr__(self, "message_key", "engineering.domain." + self.code.value.lower())


def from_reference_error(refusal: ReferenceError) -> DomainError:
    """Translate a known constructor refusal at an explicit business boundary.

    Preserve the former safe extension-code mapping without exception text;
    unrelated programming exceptions are not accepted or caught here.
    """
    if type(refusal) is not ReferenceError:
        raise TypeError("Expected ReferenceError at domain refusal boundary")
    try:
        code = DomainErrorCode(refusal.code)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        code = DomainErrorCode.INVALID_SCHEMA
    return DomainError(code)
